Examination reveals fundal height equivalent to 18 weeks' size. Ultrasound confirms lack of fetal heart activity and no fetal movement. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Passed tissue + cervix مقفل + نزيف خفيف ← Complete abortion. cervix مفتوح ← Incomplete.
q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman with 7 weeks' amenorrhea presented to the clinic with a history of passing tissue at home and vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed mild vaginal bleeding with a closed cervix. Which of the following is the most likely abortion type?

h: Bleeding + cervix مقفل + fetus حي ← Threatened abortion. Missed ← fetus ميت.
q: A 33-year-old 7 weeks' pregnant woman presented with mild vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed a closed cervix. Ultrasound: A 7-week viable intrauterine pregnancy. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion she had?

h: Heartbeat موجود + cervix مقفل ← Threatened. لو لا heartbeat ← Missed abortion.
q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time, missing her period. LMP was 9 weeks ago, and she had a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with mild bleeding. Transvaginal ultrasonography: Intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length of 9 weeks of gestation with positive embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?

h: Cervix مفتوح + fetus حي ← Inevitable abortion. بعد ما يطلع tissue ← Incomplete.
q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman presented with abdominal cramps and mild vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed an open cervix with mild bleeding. Ultrasound: A 7-week viable intrauterine pregnancy. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion she had?

h: Tissue طلع + cervix مفتوح + tissue بالرحم ← Incomplete abortion.
q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman presented with a history of vaginal bleeding and passed tissue at home. Examination revealed an open cervix. Ultrasound: Intrauterine tissue. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion she had?

h: Incomplete + نزيف ← Evacuation. لو نزيف قليل ← expectant أو misoprostol.
q: A 33-year-old 7 weeks' pregnant woman presented with vaginal bleeding and a history of passing tissue at home. Examination revealed an open cervix with moderate vaginal bleeding. Ultrasound: Intrauterine 3x4 cm tissue seen. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Threatened abortion ← Conservative (راحة ومتابعة). لا D&C.
q: A 30-year-old 7 weeks' pregnant woman presented with mild vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed a closed cervix. Ultrasound: 7 weeks' viable intrauterine pregnancy. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: نزيف بالثلث الثالث: ابدئي ABC أول (٢ IV lines كبيرة) قبل فحص أو scan. لا vaginal exam قبل exclude previa.
q: A 30-year-old 33 weeks' pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with lower abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: نزيف بدون ألم ← Placenta previa ← ultrasound لتحديد الـplacenta قبل أي فحص مهبلي.
q: A 33-year-old 32 weeks' pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with mild painless vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
o: Observe the bleeding over an hour

h: أشيع سبب لـearly miscarriage ← Chromosomal abnormality.
q: A 26-year-old 9 weeks pregnant woman, presented with vaginal bleeding and subsequently had a spontaneous abortion. Which of the following is the most common cause?

h: Complete abortion مستقر ← Reassure. لو tissue باقي ← Evacuation.
q: A 10-week pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with a history of abdominal cramping and vaginal bleeding. She passed some tissue at home. Examination revealed normal vital signs with a closed cervix (see report). Ultrasound: Shows an empty uterus. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: الأول ← Crown-rump length (أدق للـfirst trimester).
q: A 29-year-old woman presented to the clinic unsure of her gestational age. She missed her period 3 months ago but her periods are irregular (see report). Ultrasound: Determined gestational age as 11 weeks. Which of the following was measured in the ultrasound to determine gestational age?

h: Early miscarriage ← Chromosomal abnormalities. لو recurrent second-trimester ← cervical insufficiency.
q: A 28-year-old woman had a spontaneous abortion at 8 weeks. She is concerned regarding the cause of her abortion. Which of the following is the most common cause?

h: Rh-negative + bleeding ← Anti-D.
q: A 28-year-old pregnant woman presented at 20 weeks with spotting. No history of trauma. Her blood group is O negative (see report). Ultrasound: Normal-sized fetus, normal placentation, and long cervix. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: Molar pregnancy ← Serum hCG + Ultrasound ثم evacuation.
q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman in her 10th week presented with spotting and pain. Examination revealed the uterus was larger than expected and pelvic examination showed vesicles passing through the internal os. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: الـCRL أدق parameter بالـfirst trimester.
q: A 31-year-old woman presented with a positive pregnancy test to the antenatal clinic. She is not sure of her last menstrual period as she is lactating. Pelvic ultrasound was requested for dating her pregnancy. Which of the following parameters has the highest diagnostic value for dating pregnancy?

h: Obese + DM + دورة كل ٣–٤ شهور ← Chronic anovulation (PCOS) ← unopposed estrogen.
q: A 29-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with a very heavy period. She is morbidly obese and diabetic. Her periods are irregular, occurring every 3-4 months. She had her period 2 weeks ago and it has not stopped, with heavy clots. Pregnancy test is negative. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Preterm labor: Dexamethasone + Tocolytic (nifedipine) + GBS prophylaxis.
q: A 28-year-old G1 P0 woman presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with abdominal pain with no leaking or bleeding. The CTG shows a normal heart rate with regular contractions 4 in 10 minutes. She was admitted with preterm labor, as her cervix was 2 cm dilated and 80% effaced. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: This is a threatened preterm labor, so observation

h: نزيف + ألم + contractions ← Abruption. نزيف بدون ألم ← Previa.
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with profuse vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain. CTG showed a normal heart rate with regular contractions. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: نزيف شديد بدون ألم + بدون contractions ← Placenta previa.
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, who has been missing her clinic appointments, presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with profuse vaginal bleeding. She had no pain, and the baby was moving well. CTG showed a normal heart rate with no contractions. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: تأكيد preterm labor ← Vaginal exam لتقييم cervix. contractions وحدها لا تكفي.
q: A 25-year-old woman G1 P0 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with regular uterine contractions. She had no vaginal bleeding or leaking. CTG showed a normal heart rate and four contractions in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassure the patient and discharge home
Perform an ultrasound to check fetal weight
Perform a vaginal exam to assess cervical dilation

h: Mass بعد ولادة تنزف + hCG ← شك Choriocarcinoma ← Metastatic workup (بدون biopsy).
q: A 29-year-old woman presents to the clinic with 3-month postpartum abnormal vaginal bleeding. An examination reveals a fleshy vaginal mass protruding from the cervix that bleeds on touch (see report). Ultrasound: A mass protruding from the cervix, involving the uterine cavity. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: Sac بدون heartbeat عند ٥ أسابيع ← Uncertain viability (مبكر). عند CRL ≥ ٧ مم ← missed.
q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time after missing her period, with a positive home pregnancy test. Her last menstrual period was 5 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with no bleeding (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with no embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: CRL ٩ أسابيع بدون heartbeat + cervix مقفل ← Missed abortion.
q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time after missing her period, LMP 9 weeks ago, and with a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with no bleeding (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length of 9 weeks' gestation with no embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?

h: Fetal demise بدون expulsion ← Missed abortion.
q: A 34-year-old woman presents at 10 weeks of gestation to the Emergency Department with fetal death, without expulsion of any fetal tissue for at least 8 weeks. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?

h: Open cervix + sac برز + heartbeat ← Inevitable miscarriage.
q: An 18-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time after she missed her period, LMP 9 weeks ago, and with a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals an open cervical os with membranes protruding through the cervix (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length of 9 weeks' gestation with a positive embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: نفس الصورة + مريضة مو بخير/ fever ← Septic miscarriage.
q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of vaginal bleeding and feeling unwell. She missed her period and has a positive home pregnancy test. Her last menstrual period was 9 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals an open cervical os with the gestational sac protruding through the cervix (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length corresponding to 9 weeks' gestation with a positive heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Threatened مستقر ← Reassure ومتابعة. المفتاح: Admit وstabilize (حسب السؤال).
q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of vaginal bleeding and abdominal cramping. She has a positive home pregnancy test, and her last menstrual period was 9 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervix with bleeding noted through (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: Intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length corresponding to 9 weeks' gestation with a positive heartbeat. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment plan?
o: Reassure and evaluate after 1 week's duration
Admit, stabilize, and prepare for possible termination of pregnancy

h: Bleeding بالأول ← Pelvic assessment (speculum + bimanual) لتقييم cervix.
q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of mild vaginal bleeding and abdominal cramping. Her last period was 9 weeks ago, and she has a positive home pregnancy test (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasonography: Intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length corresponding to 9 weeks' gestation with a positive heartbeat. Which of the following would be the most appropriate next step?

h: نزيف + cervix مفتوح ← Transvaginal ultrasound لتحديد النوع.
q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of mild vaginal bleeding and abdominal cramping. She missed her period along with a positive home pregnancy test, and her LMP was 6 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals an open cervical os with mild vaginal bleeding through the cervix. Which of the following would be the most appropriate next step?
o: Reassure the patient and evaluate in 10 days

h: Cervical motion tenderness + نزيف + ٦ أسابيع ← Transvaginal ultrasound (استبعدي ectopic).
q: A 19-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of abdominal cramps and mild vaginal bleeding. Her LMP was 6 weeks ago, with a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with abdominal pain on manipulation of the cervix. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Perform a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis
Perform a deeper pelvic assessment to rule out masses

h: PPH أكثر من ٢٤ ساعة إلى ١٢ أسبوع ← Late (secondary) postpartum. أول ٢٤ ساعة ← Primary.
q: A patient presents 3 weeks after vaginal delivery with sudden vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?

h: أول ٢٤ ساعة ← Early/primary postpartum hemorrhage.
q: A patient presents 10 hours after vaginal delivery with sudden vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?

h: نزيف بعد ٢٠ أسبوع قبل labor ← Antepartum hemorrhage.
q: A patient presents at 32 weeks of gestation with sudden vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?

h: نزيف أثناء labor ← Intrapartum hemorrhage.
q: A patient at 32 weeks of gestation is 7 cm dilated, suddenly develops vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?

h: Cervix مفتوح بدون expulsion ← Inevitable abortion.
q: A 33-year-old woman P2+3 is seen in the Emergency Department at 12 weeks of gestation with vaginal bleeding and lower abdominal pain. Digital pelvic examination revealed the cervix is partially dilated without passage of any products of conception. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?

h: Cervix مقفل + fetal heart موجود ← Threatened abortion.
q: A 25-year-old woman P1+1 presented at 13 weeks of gestation with vaginal bleeding. Abdominal examination revealed the uterus is palpable at the symphysis pubis with a positive fetal heart. Vaginal examination revealed a closed cervix. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?

h: Tissue طلع جزئيًا ← Incomplete abortion.
q: A 23-year-old woman presented at 10 weeks of gestation with a history of vaginal bleeding, cramp-like pain, and passage of some placental tissue through the cervix. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?

h: Recurrent first-trimester loss ← Karyotyping (الزوجين) أول. Second-trimester ← uterine/cervical.
q: A 31-year-old woman is seen in the Antenatal Clinic. She gave a history of a previous recurrent abortion in the first trimester of pregnancy. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?

h: Previa totalis + نزيف سابق ← Admit فورًا ثم planned cesarean.
q: A 39-year-old woman presented at 37 weeks of gestation with scanty vaginal bleeding. She is a known case of placenta previa totalis with a history of two previous episodes of vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most advisable time for admission?
o: If she has another episode of bleeding

h: Previa + نزيف خفيف وتوقف ← CTG لتقييم الجنين (ultrasound معروفة).
q: A 33-year-old woman, known case of low-lying placenta, presented at 35 weeks of gestation with mild vaginal bleeding at home. Examination revealed her vital signs are normal, and no more bleeding is noted. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Beta-agonist ← Palpitations/tachycardia (وhypokalemia وpulmonary edema).
q: A 34-year-old woman at 27 weeks of gestation presented with preterm labor. She is started on Beta mimetics (tocolytics). Which of the following is the most common side effect?

h: ألم + contractions + smoker ← Abruption. نزيف بدون ألم ← Previa.
q: A 24-year-old woman, known smoker, presented at 31 weeks of gestation with painful vaginal bleeding and uterine contractions. Fetal heart on CTG shows late decelerations. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: بدون ألم + uterus طري + previous CS ← Placenta previa.
q: A 36-year-old woman with a previous history of two cesarean sections presented at 30 weeks of gestation with painless vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed, the uterus is soft, and the fetal heart rate is normal. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: نزيف مؤلم + uterine tenderness ← Abruption.
q: A 34-year-old pregnant woman at 36 weeks of gestation presented with acute painful vaginal bleeding associated with uterine tenderness. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Previa مستقرة قبل ٣٤ أسبوع ← Steroids (احتمال preterm delivery) + admit.
q: A 30-year-old woman attends at 27 weeks of gestation with scanty vaginal bleeding. An ultrasound confirms placenta previa totalis. She is hemodynamically stable, and CTG is normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Grand multipara + ألم + توقف contractions + bradycardia ← Uterine rupture ← Laparotomy فورًا.
q: A 35-year-old G8P7 woman presents in labor at 37 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix was found to be 10 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station. She suddenly complains of severe abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 80 beats per minute, poor variability with recurrent late decelerations. Uterine contractions suddenly stopped being recorded on the CTG trace. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: بعد delivery placenta كامل + macrosomia ← Check uterine contractility (atony أول).
q: A 30-year-old woman delivered a 4.2 kg baby without an episiotomy being required. The placenta was completely delivered by continuous cord traction. Post-delivery, the patient started to have a sudden gush of heavy vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
o: Request blood for complete blood count

h: Previous CS + labor + ألم شديد + shock ← Uterine rupture.
q: A 33-year-old woman G5P4 with a history of 4 previous cesarean sections presents at 37 weeks of gestation to the Emergency Room complaining of contractions that started 8 hours ago. The pain progressed to become severe with moderate vaginal bleeding, and low blood pressure. She became restless and hyperventilated. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: نزيف بدون ألم بالثلث الثالث ← Ultrasound (لتحديد previa) قبل أي فحص مهبلي.
q: A 30-year-old woman at 36 weeks of gestation presents with painless vaginal bleeding for one day. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?

h: العمر يرفع خطر miscarriage (≥ ٤٠ ← ٣٠–٥٠٪+). المفتاح: بين ١٠–٥٠٪.
q: A 50-year-old woman had a recent miscarriage and is inquiring if her age contributed to the miscarriage. Which of the following is the most appropriate response?
o: Age is not related to miscarriage
80% chance of miscarriage due to her age

h: Painless mid-trimester loss ← Cervical incompetence (cerclage بالحمل القادم).
q: A 23-year-old woman presents at 18 weeks of gestation with a sudden unexpected rupture of membranes followed by painless expulsion of products of conception. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Painless + mid-trimester ← Cervical incompetence.
q: A 25-year-old woman in her mid-trimester of pregnancy presents with a sudden unexpected rupture of membranes followed by painless expulsion of the products of conception. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Smoking > ٢٠ ← يزيد miscarriage. Folate يمنع NTD مو miscarriage.
q: A 25-year-old woman was diagnosed to have a complete abortion at 10 weeks of gestation. The patient is a heavy smoker and smokes more than 20 cigarettes a day. She was not taking any folic acid or dietary supplements. Which of the following is the most likely risk that caused the miscarriage?
o: Smoking more than 20 cigarettes a day

h: Doughy uterus أكبر من العمر + amenorrhea ← Molar pregnancy ← Ultrasound أول (snowstorm) ثم hCG.
q: A 50-year-old otherwise healthy woman presents to the Emergency Room with a history of amenorrhea for the last 17 weeks. Examination revealed normal vital signs. The uterine size corresponds to 20 weeks of gestation and feels doughy. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
o: CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis

h: Snowstorm + بدون fetal pole + hCG عالي ← Complete mole. Partial ← fetal parts + triploidy.
q: A 17-year-old patient presents with a period of amenorrhea for the last 18 weeks. The uterus is about 22 weeks in size and feels doughy and compressible. Ultrasound: A snowstorm appearance with no clearly identified fetal pole. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Uterus أكبر من dates + نزيف ← Complete mole (hCG عالي، snowstorm).
q: A 30-year-old, 12 weeks pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed her fundal height corresponded with 19 weeks of gestation. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Grape-like + vesicles ← Complete mole. Partial ← fetal tissue موجود.
q: An 18-year-old patient presents with amenorrhea for the last 15 weeks. She complains of vaginal bleeding and passage of tissue that she describes as vesicles. Ultrasound: A grape-like structure is filling the uterine cavity completely. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: بعد mole (حتى partial) ← hCG أسبوعيًا لين سلبي ثم متابعة.
q: A 44-year-old woman was just recently diagnosed with partial molar pregnancy, which was confirmed by histopathology. Which of the following is the most appropriate follow-up plan?

h: Hyperemesis بالمفتاح مرتبط بنقص folate. فكري بنقص folate لو macrocytic anemia.
q: A 26-year-old woman primigravida at 16 weeks' gestation presents to the clinic complaining of nausea and vomiting. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this condition?

h: Fetal ascites + skin edema = Hydrops (أشد). MCA Doppler PSV عالي ← فقر دم الجنين.
q: A pregnant woman with prenatal diagnosis of Rhesus (Rh) alloimmunization had an ultrasound scan during follow-up. Which of the following is the most diagnostic sign?
o: Low fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) Doppler peak systolic velocity

h: ٣٠٠ mcg anti-D يحمي من ~١٥ mL fetal red cells (≈ ٣٠ mL fetal whole blood).
q: A 26-year-old average-size woman has delivered a baby boy within the last 24 hours. During the morning round in the post-partum ward, it was found that her blood group is B-, her husband is O+, and her son is A+. A 300-g dose of anti-D immunoglobulin was prescribed. Which of the following volume of fetal blood will be protected by the prescribed dose?

h: Physiologic ← Follow-up. لو gush ماء ← PROM. لو pruritic/نتن ← infection.
q: A 36-year-old woman G2 P1 AO L1 at 32 weeks gestation presents for routine prenatal care. Past medical history is unremarkable. Current pregnancy has been uncomplicated, with occasional Braxton Hicks contractions and increasing non-pruritic vaginal discharge like cervical mucus. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: بعد ولادة طفل Rh+ ← ٣٠٠ mcg anti-D خلال ٧٢ ساعة (حتى لو أخذت ٢٨ أسبوع).
q: A 22-year-old primigravida who is Rh-negative delivered an Rh-positive infant. She received routine prophylactic Rh immunoglobulin at 28 weeks of gestation. What dose of anti-D immunoglobulin should she receive after delivery?

h: Polyhydramnios ← Uncontrolled diabetes. Renal agenesis ← oligohydramnios.
q: A 41-year-old woman is seen at 34 weeks of gestation in the antenatal clinic with an ultrasound report confirming excessive amniotic fluid. Which of the following is the common cause?

h: Fetal anemia عند ٣٧ أسبوع ← Immediate delivery. قبل ٣٥ ← Intrauterine transfusion.
q: A 30-year-old woman G3P2 is at 37 weeks of gestation. She is a case of Rh isoimmunization and the fetus is diagnosed with fetal anemia. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Uterine atony ← Oxytocin IV. مع preeclampsia تجنبي ergometrine (يرفع الضغط).
q: A pregnant woman with preeclampsia has just delivered and has a lax uterus with moderate postpartum hemorrhage. Physical examination reveals no laceration or retained product of conception. Which of the following medical therapies is most recommended?
o: 20 units oxytocin in a 500 mL of D5W given intravenously

h: PPH بسبب heparin ← Protamine sulfate. لو uterine atony ← Uterotonics.
q: A 22-year-old pregnant woman at 40 weeks of gestation was diagnosed with DVT and started on a therapeutic dose of heparin. The patient had a normal vaginal delivery. Shortly after a heparin injection, she sustained postpartum hemorrhage. The uterus was contracted and examination revealed no lacerations. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

h: Pregestational DM ← Congenital malformations. GDM ما يسبب malformations.
q: A 32-year-old G2 Pi AO at 12 weeks of gestation. She is a known case of IDDM for 12 years and attended the Antenatal Clinic. Which of the following will most likely increase markedly in this patient?

h: Uterine inversion ← Fundal placenta (+ traction زيادة). عالجي reduction فورًا.
q: A 30-year-old G4 P3003 woman at 39 weeks' gestation delivered a baby boy weighing 30.5 kg. Upon delivery of her placenta, an inverted uterus was noted and successfully reduced. Which placental site was the most likely predisposing factor?

h: Retained placenta ٣٠ دقيقة ← Manual extraction. لو نزيف شديد قبلها ← تدخل أبكر.
q: A 25-year-old woman underwent a normal vaginal delivery at term. After 30 minutes, the placenta is still in place. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Attempt manual extraction of the placenta

h: PPH فشل medical + تبي حمل ← Internal iliac artery ligation (أو B-Lynch). Hysterectomy last resort.
q: A 27-year-old woman primigravida has severe uterine bleeding that exceeds 700 cc after a normal vaginal delivery which does not respond to medical treatment. The obstetrician in charge decided to go for surgical management. The patient desires future pregnancies. Which of the following structures is the most appropriate to ligate in her case in order to stop the bleeding?

h: Abruption + bleeding من أماكن كثيرة = DIC ← عالجي Coagulopathy أول.
q: A 30-year-old GS P3013 woman presented in labor at term. She had a vaginal delivery complicated by abruption placenta. She was then noted to have significant uterine bleeding. The team in charge noted she had bleeding from multiple venipuncture sites. Which of the following is the best next step in management?

h: PPH بعد ساعة ← Atony أشيع سبب (4 T's: Tone، Trauma، Tissue، Thrombin).
q: A 38-year-old woman, known for low-lying placenta, delivered a normal vaginal delivery. One hour post-delivery, she had postpartum hemorrhage. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: PPH أشيع سبب ← Uterine atony.
q: A 24-year-old woman just delivered her first baby with a birth weight of 2.7 kg while she was at 38 weeks of gestation. She is not known to have any medical or surgical history. She has a heavy gush of bleeding postpartum. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Heavy menstrual bleeding ← Tranexamic acid.
q: A 45-year-old woman came to the clinic complaining of heavy periods lasting more than 10 days. Pregnancy test is negative and ultrasound is normal. Which of the following medication is the most appropriate to use?

h: Macrosomia ← Atony (risk factor).
q: A 36-year-old woman G4 P3 L2, whose previous pregnancies were delivered normally without complications, had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 5 hours of labor. She delivered a baby boy weighing 4600 g and, after placental delivery, started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?

h: Twins ← Atony/overdistension (risk factor للـPPH).
q: A 36-year-old woman G4 P3 L2, whose previous pregnancies were delivered normally, had an uneventful twin pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 5 hours of labor. She delivered healthy twin boys weighing 2800 g and 2900 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?

h: Prolonged labor ← Atony (risk factor).
q: A 32-year-old woman G4 P3 L2 had normal deliveries with no prenatal or postnatal complications. She had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 16 hours of labor. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?

h: Grand multipara (≥ 5) ← Atony (risk factor).
q: A 32-year-old woman G7 P6 L6 had normal deliveries with no prenatal or postnatal complications. She had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 7 hours of labor. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?

h: Precipitous labor (أقل من ٣ ساعات) ← Atony/laceration.
q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 had an uneventful pregnancy and a spontaneous vaginal delivery after 2 hours of labor, just making it to the hospital. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?

h: PPH medical: Oxytocin أول، ثم Misoprostol/Methergine/Carboprost (المفتاح Misoprostol).
q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication for managing her postpartum hemorrhage?

h: Forceps + lacerations ← Genital tract trauma. الرحم صلب والنزيف مستمر.
q: A 33-year-old woman is seen post-delivery with postpartum hemorrhage. She had a forceps delivery of a 3.7 kg baby. Examination revealed laceration of the cervix, vagina, and the perineal body. Which of the following is the most likely cause of postpartum hemorrhage?

h: PPH عند ITP ← Platelet concentrate.
q: A 23-year-old woman, a known case of idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura, delivered at 39 weeks of gestation, and her delivery was complicated with postpartum hemorrhage. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Rectal mucosa ← Fourth-degree. Third ← anal sphincter فقط.
q: A 36-year-old woman has a normal vaginal delivery of a 4.2 kg baby. Post-delivery, she had a perineal laceration involving the rectal mucosa. Which of the following is the most likely degree of the laceration?

h: Bandl's ring + تقدم بطيء ← Obstructed labor.
q: A 22-year-old PG at 39 weeks of gestation admitted to the Labor Room with active labor. Initial cervical examination revealed 5 cm dilatation with 60% effacement and station was at -2. After 6 hours despite regular adequate contractions, abdominal examination revealed the presence of a retraction ring and vaginal examination showed cervical dilatation of 7 cm and station of -1. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: ألم + uterus صلب ← Abruption. نزيف بدون ألم + uterus طري ← Placenta previa.
q: A 28-year-old PG presents at 34 weeks of pregnancy with constant abdominal pain and moderate bleeding. Her symphysiofundal height is 37 cm, and her uterus is tender and firm. CTG: Unprovoked decelerations. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: بعد abruption ← High-risk care + serial growth scans.
q: A 27-year-old primigravida with a low-risk pregnancy is admitted at 32 weeks with antepartum hemorrhage and diagnosed with placental abruption. Bleeding settled with conservative management. Which of the following is the most appropriate antenatal care plan?
o: Reassure and continue with "low risk" care
Reclassify as "High Risk" pregnancy care with serial ultrasound for fetal growth
Reassure and continue with "low risk" care and serial ultrasound for signs of bleeding

h: Trait ← UTI أكثر. Disease ← crises وIUGR وpreeclampsia.
q: A 30-year-old woman with known sickle cell trait attends an antenatal booking clinic at 8 weeks' gestation. Which of the following antenatal complications is significantly more common in her case?

h: Polyhydramnios + rupture + bradycardia ← Cord prolapse ← فحص مهبلي فورًا + C-section.
q: A 36-year-old G4 P3003 is admitted in preterm labor at 36+5 weeks with polyhydramnios. Fetal bradycardia is noted after spontaneous rupture of membranes. Which of the following needs to be excluded by a prompt vaginal examination?

h: Previa بدون accreta ← ٣٨ أسبوع. Accreta ← ٣٤–٣٧ أسبوع (المفتاح ٣٦–٣٧).
q: A 36-year-old G3 P2002 with 2 previous caesarean sections is diagnosed with major placenta previa and placenta accreta at 32 weeks' gestation. When is an elective caesarean section recommended for delivery?

h: المفتاح: Not affected. (accreta مرتبط أكثر بـprevious CS + previa).
q: A 30-year-old married, nulligravid woman with symptomatic multiple uterine fibroids, all subserosal, underwent myomectomy. According to her operative note, the endometrial cavity was entered during surgery. What is the risk of placenta accreta during future pregnancies?

h: PPROM + fever + ألم ← Chorioamnionitis.
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 presented 3 days ago to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with preterm premature rupture of membranes. She was managed expectantly and today she started to have fever and abdominal pain. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: PPROM + fever + discharge نتن ← Chorioamnionitis.
q: A 26-year-old woman presents at 29 weeks of gestation with prelabor premature rupture of membranes for 7 days. Examination revealed she is having lower abdominal pain, rigors, and fever with purulent, foul-smelling vaginal discharge. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Attached للعضلة ← Accreta (increta عميق في العضلة، percreta تخترق).
q: A 35-year-old woman with a history of three previous cesarean sections is admitted for elective surgery at 37 weeks of gestation. The placenta is found to be attached deeply into the uterus. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: IUFD + abruption + labor قائمة ← Augmentation (vaginal delivery). Cesarean لو نزيف كثير.
q: A 33-year-old woman diagnosed with abruptio placentae presented with intrauterine fetal death. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 5 cm dilated with mild uterine contractions. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: Massive APH + fetal distress ← Cesarean فورًا.
q: A 30-year-old woman presented to the maternity unit at 30 weeks of gestation with massive antepartum hemorrhage. CTG is showing fetal distress. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: حمل ٣٨ أسبوع + preeclampsia/HELLP ← Delivery. لو TTP (بدون حمل) ← Plasma exchange.
q: A 34-year-old woman at 38 weeks gestation is evaluated for a severe headache. Her only medication is a prenatal vitamin. Neurologic and cardiopulmonary examination is normal. She has a gravid uterus and 2+ edema of the lower extremities. No petechiae or ecchymoses are seen (see lab results and report). Peripheral smear: Occasional fragmented erythrocytes without platelet clumping. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: الـACEi/ARB ← fetal malformation (المفتاح)، وبالثلث ٢–٣ renal dysgenesis. البديل ← Methyldopa/labetalol/nifedipine.
q: A 39-year-old woman presented to the family medicine clinic for counseling as she is planning to get pregnant. She gave a history of hypertension and is controlled on an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEI). Her physician asked her to change the medication as it is contraindicated during pregnancy. Which of the following is the most likely effect of ACEI on pregnancy?
o: Increases the rate of fetal malformation
Increases the rate of premature rupture of membranes
Leads to a significant drop in blood pressure during pregnancy

h: آمنة بالحمل: labetalol، nifedipine، methyldopa. الممنوعة: ACE inhibitors/ARB.
q: A 28-year-old Primigravida at 8 weeks of gestation is known to have chronic hypertension and presented to Antenatal Clinic. Which of the following antihypertensive medications is contraindicated?

h: Aspirin (٧٥–١٥٠ mg) من ١٢ أسبوع يقلل preeclampsia وFGR.
q: A 28-year-old G4 P3 AO at 12 weeks of gestation with a prior history of preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction presented to the Antenatal Clinic. Which of the following will most likely reduce the risk of growth restriction and preeclampsia?

h: DM ← hydramnios، macrosomia، preeclampsia تزيد. Cystic fibrosis (وراثي) ما يتأثر.
q: A 28-year-old diabetic on insulin with no significant family history is concerned about pregnancy. Which of the following risks is the same for her as for the general population?

h: RUQ pain في preeclampsia ← Liver capsule distension (HELLP/eclampsia وشيك).
q: A 30-year-old PG at 30 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia complaining of right upper quadrant abdominal pain. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

h: Antihypertensive يحمي الأم (stroke)، ما يحسن نتيجة الجنين.
q: A 27-year-old G3 P2 AO L2 at 34 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia. Which of the following is the rationale behind giving antihypertensive medications?
o: Decrease risk of maternal complications such as stroke

h: Preeclampsia ← Plasma volume ينزل، وurea وuric acid وcreatinine ترتفع.
q: A 30-year-old G4 P3 AO L3 at 34 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia. Which of the following is most likely to be decreased significantly?

h: Captopril (ACE inhibitor) ممنوع. الآمنة: nifedipine، hydralazine، labetalol، methyldopa.
q: A 30-year-old primigravida at 30 weeks of gestation newly diagnosed with preeclampsia. Which of the following antihypertensives is contraindicated?

h: Unfavorable cervix ← Prostaglandin E2. Favorable ← Oxytocin.
q: A 23-year-old primigravida admitted for induction of labor. The cervix is closed and 3.5 cm long. Which of the following is the most appropriate agent to be given to her for cervical ripening?

h: Preeclampsia ← Proteinuria (٣٠٠ mg/24h أو أكثر).
q: A 38-year-old primigravida at 35 weeks gestation complains of a mild headache and facial edema. Her reflexes are brisk, and she is suspected of having preeclampsia. Which of the following is likely to show in the urinalysis?

h: BP ≥ 160/110 ← Admit + treat. أقل من ذلك ← مراقبة.
q: A 19-year-old primigravida is referred at 32 weeks' gestation due to raised blood pressure. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Admit for 6-hourly blood pressure monitoring and 24-hour urine protein
Discharge back to her family physician with advice for daily blood pressure and urine protein

h: RUQ pain بالحمل المتأخر ← Hepatic capsule distension (HELLP/preeclampsia). Hepatic rupture نادر ويصاحبه shock.
q: A 40-year-old G4 P30Q3 at 32 weeks' gestation presented to the hospital with right upper quadrant pain. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her pain?

h: Severe preeclampsia (بعد stabilization + steroids) ← Delivery. المفتاح: Induction of labor.
q: A 25-year-old G2 POO1O at 33 weeks' gestation referred to the hospital with a BP of 160/110 mmHg on a routine appointment. Her BP at her first booking visit at 8 weeks was 124/70 mmHg with trace proteinuria. Further detailed history revealed that she was also complaining of headaches with no history of migraines. She was started on antihypertensives and magnesium sulfate along with steroid injections (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Bed rest to term and spontaneous labor
Bed rest to 37 weeks' gestation and induction of labor
Immediate induction of labor for anticipated vaginal delivery

h: الحمل + epilepsy مستقرة ← كمّلي نفس الدواء (لا تتغيرين بعد الحمل). Valproate ← بدّليه قبل الحمل.
q: A 26-year-old woman presented to the clinic pregnant at 15 weeks. She is known to have epilepsy and is taking Phenytoin. The last convulsion was 6 years ago. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Refer to Neurology to stop the medication

h: Severe preeclampsia ← Magnesium sulfate (وقاية seizures) + antihypertensive + delivery.
q: A 28-year-old primigravida came to the clinic at 38 weeks for a regular check-up. Her blood pressure was 170/110 mmHg. A urine dipstick showed +3 protein. Her blood work was taken, and she was sent to the labor and delivery room. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: الـdrug of choice لـeclampsia ← Magnesium sulfate (مو diazepam ولا phenytoin).
q: A 22-year-old G2 P1 A0 L1 at 33 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia. Which of the following is the most appropriate drug of choice to prevent eclampsia?

h: أعراض severe preeclampsia + labor ← Magnesium sulfate.
q: A 25-year-old woman in her first pregnancy presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. Examination shows her cervix is 2 cm dilated, 75% effaced, and she is contracting every 2 minutes. The fetal heart tracing is in the 140s and reactive (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassure the patient that everything is within normal

h: ACEi/ARB ← بدّليها قبل الحمل بـmethyldopa/labetalol/nifedipine.
q: A 35-year-old woman presented to the clinic for preconception counseling. She is known to have hypertension and is on ACE inhibitors. Which of the following is the most appropriate for her antihypertensive medication when she gets pregnant?
o: Continue on ACE inhibitors as it is safe
Continue because the benefit outweighs the risk
Cannot be stopped, so she should not get pregnant
Switch to alternative antihypertensive due to fetal kidney teratogenicity

h: أعراض preeclampsia severe بـ٣٩ أسبوع ← Delivery. قبل ٣٤ أسبوع ← stabilize + steroids.
q: A 32-year-old woman G2 P1 L1. She is 39 weeks pregnant with normal prenatal care, presented to the Emergency Room with headache and blurred vision (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Admit for observation and repeat testing

h: Induction ← Prostaglandin E2 لو cervix غير ناضج. Oxytocin لو ناضج.
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, post-date with dates confirmed by early scan, followed up weekly with normal CTG and amniotic fluid index. Her doctor planned for induction of labor. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication?

h: Headache + blurred vision + ألم بطن ← Preeclampsia (severe features). Seizure ← Eclampsia.
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. There was no leaking or bleeding. CTG showed normal heart rate and no contraction (see lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Preeclampsia risk: Multiple gestation، primigravida، DM، HTN مزمن، obesity، age.
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. After assessment, CTG showed a normal heart rate with no contractions (see lab result). Which of the following is the most likely risk factor for preeclampsia?

h: Preeclampsia + seizure ← Eclampsia. Epilepsy معروفة قبل الحمل ← ليست.
q: A 25-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. After assessment, she started to have a grand mal seizure (see lab result). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Eclampsia ← Magnesium + stabilize ثم Delivery (مو antiepileptic عادي).
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. After assessment, she started to have a grand mal seizure (see lab result). Which of the following is the most appropriate management plan?

h: PPROM ← Erythromycin + ampicillin (latency) + dexamethasone. Tocolysis ما يفيد.
q: A 25-year-old woman G1 P0 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with vaginal leaking. Detailed history and physical examination confirmed preterm premature rupture of membranes. Her CTG showed a normal heart rate with no contractions. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: Eclampsia ← ABC أول (Airway) ثم Magnesium sulfate ثم antihypertensive.
q: A 27-year-old woman, primigravida at 31 weeks of gestation, presented to the Emergency Department with tonic-clonic convulsions for the first time. Examination revealed she is unconscious, with a soft abdomen, fundal height corresponding to gestational age, and a positive fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate first step in the management?

h: أفضل parameter لـfetal weight ← Abdominal circumference.
q: A 39-year-old woman, a known case of chronic hypertension, presented at 37 weeks of gestation to the antenatal clinic for follow-up. Examination revealed that the uterine fundal height lags more than 3 cm behind the gestational age. What is the single most effective parameter for predicting fetal weight?

h: Late decel ← Change maternal position (left lateral) + O2 + IV fluids + stop oxytocin.
q: A 27-year-old woman is seen during the active stage of labor at 39 weeks of gestation. CTG shows late decelerations of the fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate action to take?

h: HTN مزمن بالحمل ← Methyldopa (أو labetalol/nifedipine). ACEi/ARB ممنوعة.
q: A 35-year-old woman known case of chronic hypertension presented at 22 weeks of gestation with a blood pressure of 140/90 mmHg. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: cervix 6 سم ← Steroids (tocolysis ما يفيد في cervix متقدم). Magnesium للـneuroprotection قبل ٣٢.
q: A 33-year-old woman presented in preterm labor at 27 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is 6 cm dilated. Which of the following is the most appropriate drug to be given?

h: Eclampsia ← Magnesium sulfate (مو phenytoin).
q: A 23-year-old primigravida presented at 29 weeks of gestation with eclamptic seizures. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Eclampsia بعد stabilization ← Delivery (مهما كان العمر).
q: A 26-year-old primigravida presented at 34 weeks of gestation with eclamptic seizures. The seizures were controlled, and her blood pressure was brought down by antihypertensive medications. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: تحت ٣٢ أسبوع ← Magnesium sulfate للـneuroprotection. Tocolytics ممنوعة مع chorioamnionitis.
q: A 27-year-old woman presented at 32 weeks of gestation with preterm labor. Her membrane was ruptured 12 hours ago, and she has been on antibiotics. She received the first dose of steroids. Which of the following is the most appropriate drug to be given?

h: Severe HTN بالحمل ← Labetalol (أو hydralazine/nifedipine). Nitroprusside آخر خيار.
q: A 20-year-old primigravida presented to the Emergency Department at 30 weeks of gestation, complaining of headache and blurred vision. Which of the following is the most appropriate antihypertensive medication?

h: Preterm labor قبل ٣٢ أسبوع ← Magnesium sulfate (neuroprotection). Tocolytic لتأخير ٤٨ ساعة.
q: A 23-year-old primigravida presented at 31 weeks of gestation with preterm labor. Examination revealed, the uterus is contracting and the cervix is closed. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: HTN + proteinuria + أعراض ← Preeclampsia.
q: A 20-year-old primigravida presented at 31 weeks of gestation with a headache and blurred vision. Urine examination by dipstick shows ++ proteinuria. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: HTN + DM بالحمل ← Review medication أول (ACEi/ARB/statins/ oral hypoglycemics).
q: A 39-year-old woman presented at 14 weeks of gestation to the antenatal clinic for booking. She is a known case of hypertension and diabetes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: Infant of diabetic mother ← RDS، hypoglycemia، macrosomia، polycythemia. Hyperglycemia مو complication.
q: A 27-year-old woman presented at full term at labor, she was having uncontrolled diabetes during this pregnancy. Which of the following neonatal complications will most likely increase?

h: Oligo ← Placental insufficiency/PROM/renal agenesis. Polyhydramnios ← Diabetes/anencephaly/duodenal atresia.
q: A 28-year-old Primigravida presented to the Antenatal Clinic for an Ultrasound scan. Ultrasound: Single viable fetus with significant lower levels of amniotic fluid (oligohydramnios). Which of the following is the most likely cause?

h: Diet أول. لو فشل ← Insulin (أو metformin).
q: A 22-year-old PG at 33 weeks of gestation newly diagnosed with gestational diabetes. Which of the following is the most appropriate first-line therapy?

h: History of GDM ← OGTT مبكر. BMI عالي أو DM بالعيلة برضو. BMI 20 ما يستدعي.
q: A 21-year-old G2 Pl AO Ll at 18 weeks of gestation presented to the obstetric clinic for the first time. The obstetrician asked for an oral glucose tolerance test. Which of the following is the most likely indication for this early request?
o: History of gestational diabetes in the previous pregnancy

h: GDM غير مسيطر + fundal > dates ← Polyhydramnios. لو twin ← كان بالـscan.
q: A 20-year-old woman in her first pregnancy came to the clinic at 32 weeks for a regular antenatal visit. She has gestational diabetes on insulin and is non-compliant with her medication. Her anatomy scan at 20 weeks was normal, and her fundal height is 38 cm. What is the most likely explanation for this difference between fundal height and gestational age?

h: أقوى risk factor مُعدّل ← Smoking (IUGR، abruption، preterm).
q: A 35-year-old primigravida is seen in the Antenatal clinic for follow-up. She is currently smoking 12-15 cigarettes/day. She also gave a history of subfertility and a family history of diabetes in a second degree relative. Which of the following is the most significant risk factor?

h: بدون أعراض + CTG ← Reassuring pattern.
q: A 35-year-old woman, G3P2 diabetic patient at 38 weeks of gestation, is planned to have induction of labor. She has no abdominal or pelvic pain, and no vaginal loss. Examination revealed the uterine size corresponds to gestational age, soft, and not tender. Pelvic examination shows the cervix is closed and uneffaced. CTG is done. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Cervical insufficiency ← Cerclage (١٢–١٤ أسبوع). لو short cervix بدون history ← Progesterone.
q: A 22-year-old G2 PO Al at 13 weeks of gestation presented to the Antenatal Clinic. In her first pregnancy, she had a painless fetal passage at 22 weeks. Which of the following interventions is most recommended for the current pregnancy?
o: Regular antenatal visits with no specific intervention

h: SROM = يتمزق أثناء labor. PROM = قبل labor ≥ ٣٧. PPROM = قبل ٣٧.
q: A 23-year-old G2 P1 at 40 weeks of gestation presented to the Emergency Room complaining of painful uterine contractions. Vaginal examination revealed cervical dilatation of 3 cm and 60% effacement. Upon admission to the Labor Room, she had a gush of clear fluid. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Tocolysis ← تأخير ٤٨ ساعة لإكمال steroids (ونقل المريضة). مو لمدّ الحمل لـ٣٧.
q: A 22-year-old PG at 30 weeks of gestation presented to the Emergency Room complaining of lower abdominal pain. Vaginal examination revealed cervical dilatation of 2 cm with 50% effacement. She was admitted to the Labor and Delivery Room. The consultant on duty decided to start her on oxytocin antagonist (atosiban) as a tocolytic. Which of the following is the rationale for using tocolytic therapy in this case?
o: Prevent preterm premature rupture of membranes
Delay labor to gain the maximum benefit from steroids

h: Absent EDF ← Deliver حوالي ٣٤ أسبوع. Reversed EDF ← Steroids ثم Delivery.
q: A 38-year-old primigravida at 33 weeks' gestation is diagnosed with small for gestational age fetus and reversed end-diastolic flow on umbilical artery Doppler. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Antenatal steroids and delivery within 1 week
Repeat ultrasound growth assessment in 2 weeks

h: Fetal distress + oxytocin ← أوقفي oxytocin. وغيري position (left lateral)، O2، IV fluids.
q: A 25-year-old primigravida at 35 weeks' gestation presents with spontaneous rupture of membranes and undergoes augmentation of labor with parenteral oxytocin. Fetal monitoring shows distress. Which of the following maneuvers will most likely improve fetal oxygenation?
o: Ceasing the oxytocin to improve placental perfusion
Placing epidural analgesia to improve utero-placental perfusion
Initiating morphine sulfate to improve pain and hence placental perfusion

h: تشخيص preterm labor ← contractions + تغيّر cervix بالفحص (digital/ cervical length).
q: A 25-year-old G1 P0 woman presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with abdominal pain. There was no leaking or bleeding. The CTG shows a normal heart rate with regular contractions 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate way to diagnose if she has preterm labor?
o: History only is enough to diagnose
CTG showing regular contractions is diagnostic
If there is no leaking, then she isn’t in preterm labor

h: PPROM + fever ← Chorioamnionitis ← Antibiotics + Delivery (لا انتظار).
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 presented 3 days ago to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with preterm premature rupture of membranes. She was managed conservatively, and today she started to have fever and abdominal pain. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Ampicillin, Gentamicin, and deliver the patient
Check the source of fever and treat accordingly

h: PPROM قديم + labor ← ابدئي بـ High vaginal swab (cultures) مع antibiotics، وclear liquor ما يدل على infection.
q: A 26-year-old G4 P3 presented at 31 weeks gestation with labor pain. She had preterm premature rupture of membranes 4 weeks ago. Today, the cervix is 3 cm dilated with clear liquor noted. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: High vaginal swab for bacterial culture and sensitivity

h: PROM بـterm + مرت ٢٤ ساعة ← Induction of labor (يقلل infection).
q: A 27-year-old woman presented at 39 weeks of gestation with a history of spontaneous rupture of membranes 24 hours ago. Examination revealed a soft abdomen, cephalic presentation, and no uterine contractions. CTG shows normal fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Indomethacin (NSAID) ← يقفل PDA مبكرًا ويقلل السائل.
q: A 29-year-old woman at 29 weeks of gestation presented with preterm labor. Which of the following tocolytics can cause patent ductus arteriosus?

h: Preterm + vertex + labor متقدم + CTG طبيعي ← Vaginal delivery.
q: A 32-year-old woman presented with preterm labor at 34 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed, Symphysis fundal height corresponds to 34 weeks, vertex presentation. Vaginal assessment revealed that the cervix is 6 cm dilated. CTG confirms normal fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate mode of delivery?

h: Labor قائم + contractions قوية + CTG طبيعي ← ARM (تسرّع labor). Tocolytics لا.
q: A 30-year-old G5P4 woman presents in labor at 34 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix was found to be 4 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station with intact membranes. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 110 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability with variable decelerations. The uterine contractions are strong and regular, occurring at a rate of 4 in 10 minutes. What would be the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Asymptomatic bacteriuria في الحامل ← عالجي. غير الحامل ← لا علاج.
q: A 33-year-old pregnant woman in her third trimester is evaluated in the clinic for her routine checkup visit. She is asymptomatic and denies a history of fever, dysuria, or urgency. Her examination is unremarkable (see lab results and report). Urine culture: Positive for Escherichia coli susceptible to different broad-spectrum antibiotics. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

h: GBS (حتى bacteriuria) ← IV Penicillin/Ampicillin وقت الولادة.
q: A 29-year-old woman, G2, Pl, at 38 weeks of gestation comes to the Labor and Delivery Ward with frequent painful contractions. Her prenatal course was significant for a urine culture that showed 100,000 colony-forming units/milliliter of Group-B streptococci and bronchial asthma, for which she uses a Ventolin inhaler. Which of the following medications should this patient be treated with during labor and delivery?

h: Pyelonephritis بالحمل ← Admit + IV antibiotics.
q: A 30-year-old G4 P3 at 30 weeks of gestation presents with severe pain in the right flank radiating to her groin. She also complains of rigors and chills. Urine analysis: Numerous pus cells. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Acyclovir يقلل الأعراض وviral shedding. بعد ٣٦ أسبوع ← suppression. Active lesions بالولادة ← C-section.
q: A 36-year-old woman (G4 P2103) at 23 weeks' gestation presents with a primary attack of herpes simplex virus infection. Acyclovir is given orally for 10 days. Which of the following is the rationale for acyclovir treatment?
o: Decrease the herpes simplex virus infection
Decrease viral shedding and current infection duration

h: Candida بالحمل ← Topical antifungal (مو oral).
q: A 33-year-old pregnant woman at 36 weeks of gestation presented with vaginal itching, burning, and irritation. Examination revealed a thick discharge with the appearance of cottage cheese in the vagina. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: HBsAg+ ← الوليد يأخذ Vaccine + HBIG معًا خلال ١٢ ساعة.
q: A 23-year-old woman found to be hepatitis B surface antigen positive at 14 weeks of gestation. Which of the following is the recommendation for the infant after birth?
o: Both hepatitis B vaccination and immunoglobulin

h: لو أقل من ١٠ أيام وخفيف ← Postpartum blues. لو hallucinations ← Postpartum psychosis.
q: A primipara presents 1 week after delivery. She is tearful, has spells of crying, and lacks appetite and sleep. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Mastitis ← Antibiotics (S. aureus) + استمرار الرضاعة. لو fluctuation ← abscess ← drainage.
q: A 30-year-old woman delivered her first baby 3 weeks ago and presented to the Emergency Room with fever, chills, and breast pain. Examination revealed the right breast is red, enlarged, and tender, with no fluctuation found (see lab result). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Reassure her and send her home
Stop breastfeeding and her symptoms will improve
Warm compressors and tight-fitting bra with enough analgesia
Antibiotics to cover Staphylococcus aureus and do breast ultrasound to rule out abscess

h: المفتاح هنا: Combined pills؟ (عادة لا قبل ٦ أسابيع). الخيارات الآمنة: progestin-only / IUD.
q: A 28-year-old woman 2 weeks postpartum came to the clinic asking for contraception. She is exclusively breastfeeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate contraceptive method for her?

h: Mastitis لا يتحسن ← Breast ultrasound + surgical review (drainage). وكمّلي الرضاعة.
q: A 27-year-old woman delivered 2 weeks ago and presented with a painful, hard mass in the right breast. She received a 4-day course of antibiotics with no improvement. Examination revealed she is febrile, and a breast abscess is suspected. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: لو ما فيه أعراض بالساق ← V/Q أو CTPA. مع أعراض الساق ← Doppler أول.
q: A 29-year-old woman in the second trimester of pregnancy presents to the Emergency Room due to progressive dyspnea for the past 24 hours. Examination reveals clear lungs and a swollen right lower limb (see lab results and report). Chest radiography: Normal. Which of the following is the most important initial diagnostic procedure?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: لو CXR طبيعي ← V/Q أحسن (radiation أقل للثدي). لو CXR abnormal ← CTPA.
q: A 30-year-old woman is evaluated for new-onset nonproductive cough and dyspnea on exertion. She is pregnant at 30 weeks gestation. Medical history is unremarkable. Her only medication is a prenatal vitamin. Cardiopulmonary examination is normal. She has a gravid uterus and 2+ edema of the lower extremities without calf tenderness. Doppler ultrasonography of both legs is negative for deep venous thrombosis (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate diagnostic test to perform next?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Valproate ← Neural tube defect. Phenytoin ← Fetal hydantoin syndrome.
q: A 30-year-old Primigravida at 17 weeks of gestation is known to have epilepsy and is on valproic acid. She was concerned about the possible risks to her baby. Which of the following fetal abnormalities is markedly increased?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Poly ← Anencephaly. Oligo ← Posterior urethral valve/renal agenesis.
q: A 36-year-old presented to the Antenatal Clinic for an Ultrasound scan. Ultrasound: Single viable fetus with significant increased levels of amniotic fluid (polyhydramnios). Which of the following is the most likely cause?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: MCA PSV أكثر من ١٫٥ MoM ← Fetal anemia. Anti-Kell ← Anemia + hydrops.
q: A 23-year-old pregnant woman at 28 weeks of gestation. Ultrasound showed fetal hydrops with high peak systolic velocity more than 1.8 MOM in the middle cerebral artery Doppler. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: BPS 8–10 ← مطمئن. ٦ ← Equivocal. ٤ أو أقل ← Delivery.
q: A 30-year-old G2 Pl AO Ll at 33 weeks of gestation presented with decreased fetal movement. Obstetric ultrasound was performed. Which of the following is the most reassuring biophysical profile score (BPS)?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: IV iron: فشل/عدم تحمل oral أو anemia شديدة أو قرب الولادة.
q: A 28-year-old G2 P1 AO at 33 weeks of twin gestation presented to the Antenatal Clinic. Her investigations confirmed iron deficiency anemia. Which of the following is an indication for intravenous iron therapy?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Fetal bradycardia + fully dilated + station +2 ← Assisted vaginal delivery (ventouse). C-section لو مو ممكن.
q: A 19-year-old G1 P0 at 42 weeks is admitted for induction of labor. Her antenatal care was uncomplicated. Examination revealed the cervix was closed and long. Prostaglandin E2 is placed vaginally. An hour later, she started to contract regularly, and the fetal heart dropped to 70 bpm and was not recovering. Her vaginal examination showed a fully dilated cervix and presenting part at +2. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Start pushing and consider applying ventouse

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Dichorionic diamniotic ← ٠–٣ أيام. Monochorionic diamniotic ← ٤–٨ أيام. Monoamniotic ← ٨–١٢. Conjoined ← > ١٢.
q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy had an ultrasound confirming Monochorionic Diamniotic twins. What was the time interval between ovulation and cleavage?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Monoamniotic ← ٩–١٢ يوم. Monochorionic diamniotic ← ٤–٨. Dichorionic ← ٠–٣ أيام (٧٢ ساعة).
q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy had an ultrasound confirming Monochorionic Monoamniotic twins. What was the time interval between ovulation and cleavage?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Dichorionic ← ٠–٣ أيام (قبل الـblastocyst). كل ما تأخر الانقسام قلّت الأغشية.
q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy had an ultrasound confirming Dichorionic Diamniotic twins. What was the time interval between ovulation and cleavage?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: ٤١ أسبوع + CTG abnormal ← Delivery. لو CTG طبيعي ← مراقبة/induction مجدولة.
q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, 41 weeks pregnant confirmed dating with an early scan, started to follow up weekly with CTG twice a week. Her CTG showed deceleration with no signs of labor. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Bradycardia بعد PGE2 + cervix مقفل ← C-section. لو fully dilated وstation +2 ← Ventouse.
q: A 19-year-old G1 P0 at 41 weeks and 4 days was admitted for induction of labor. Her antenatal care was uncomplicated. Examination revealed her cervix was closed and long. Prostaglandin E2 was placed vaginally. An hour later, she started to contract regularly, and the fetal heart dropped to 70 beats per minute and was not recovering with fluid and oxygen administration. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: شك PROM ← Sterile speculum exam (لا digital). Digital يزيد infection.
q: A 25-year-old woman G1 P0 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with vaginal leaking. After taking detailed history, she mentioned that it was a large amount of fluid and it is still ongoing. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassure the patient and discharge home
Perform an ultrasound to check fetal weight and amniotic fluid

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Meconium + CTG طبيعي ← مراقبة، غيري position. Naloxone لو depression تنفس بالوليد.
q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 was admitted at 41 weeks gestation in active labor. She had received pethidine and promethazine earlier. The cervix is 9 cm dilated, and meconium-stained liquor is draining. Non-stress test done shows no abnormalities. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
o: Change the position of the patient

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Twin A vertex + twin B vertex ← Vaginal delivery. لو twin A non-vertex ← Cesarean.
q: A 32-year-old woman with twin pregnancy, presented at 38 weeks of gestation in active labor. Examination revealed twin A is in vertex presentation, and twin B is also in vertex presentation. Both fetal heart rates are normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: شك IUGR ← Serial ultrasound (growth + Doppler).
q: A 20-year-old primigravida is seen in the Antenatal Clinic for follow-up. Clinical examination of uterine fundal height on 2 occasions revealed that there is an element of intrauterine growth restriction. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: IUGR + vertex + CTG reactive ← Vaginal delivery. لو CTG abnormal/Doppler سيئ ← Cesarean.
q: A 33-year-old woman, known case of intrauterine growth restriction, presented at 38 weeks of gestation to labor and delivery. Examination revealed the fetus is in vertex presentation, cervix is 4 cm dilated with a reactive fetal heart on CTG. Which of the following is the most appropriate mode of delivery?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Post-term + dates مؤكدة + cervix ناضج ← Induction of labor.
q: A 31-year-old woman at 42 weeks of gestation with firm dates presented to the Antenatal Clinic. Examination revealed that the fetal head is well fixed in the pelvis, and the cervix is favorable. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Reduced fetal movements ← CTG أول (+ ultrasound لو شك).
q: A 32-year-old woman presented with reduced fetal movements at 36 weeks of gestation. What is the most appropriate next step in management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Unfavorable cervix ← Prostaglandin E2.
q: A 22-year-old primigravida is admitted for induction of labor at 41 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is closed and long. Which of the following will promote cervical ripening?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Baseline 160 + decreased movement ← Observation + continuous CTG (لا تعيدينها).
q: A 23-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks of gestation complaining of decreased fetal movement for the last few hours. Examination revealed the cervix is 1 cm dilated and the head is at -2 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 160 beats per minute with good accelerations, good variability, and early decelerations. The uterine contractions are mild and regular. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Active labor + CTG مقبول ← Reassurance وإعادة التقييم بعد ٣٠–٦٠ دقيقة.
q: A 27-year-old G4P3 woman is seen in labor at 39 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is 5 cm dilated with clear amniotic fluid draining. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 140 beats per minute, no accelerations, good variability, and no decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassurance and reassessment in 30 to 60 minutes

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Bradycardia + poor variability + meconium ← Emergency cesarean.
q: A 32-year-old G2P1 woman at 41 weeks of gestation presents in labor. Examination revealed the cervix is 7 cm dilated with meconium stained amniotic fluid draining, and the head is at -2 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 100 beats per minute, with poor variability, no accelerations, and no decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: IUGR + late decel + poor variability + meconium ← Emergency cesarean.
q: A 19-year-old primigravida is diagnosed with intrauterine growth restriction in the antenatal follow-up. She came in labor at 38 weeks of gestation, the cervix is found to be 4 cm dilated with meconium-stained amniotic fluid. The cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 130 beats per minute, with no accelerations, poor variability, and recurrent late decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Post-term + CTG طبيعي ← Induction of labor (مو انتظار ٧ أيام).
q: A 32-year-old woman G3P2 at 41 weeks of gestation is seen in the outpatient clinic. Abdominal palpation revealed there are no uterine contractions. Pelvic examination revealed that the cervix is thick and not dilated. The cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 130 beats per minute, with accelerations, good variability, and no decelerations. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Decel مع contractions + head compression ← Early decelerations (طبيعي).
q: A 21-year-old healthy primigravida is at 40 weeks in active labor. Pelvic assessment reveals that the cervix is 7 cm dilated, draining clear amniotic fluid, and the head is at +1 station. She is contracting regularly, 3 contractions in every 10 minutes, and the CTG is showing decelerations. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

t: Fetal growth, fetal wellbeing & multiple pregnancy
h: Monoamniotic + twin A non-vertex ← Cesarean.
q: A 24-year-old woman is admitted to the labor and delivery unit at 37 weeks of gestation in labor. She is pregnant with monochorionic monoamniotic twins, and the first twin is in breech presentation while the second is in cephalic presentation. Examination revealed the cervix is 4 cm dilated. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: External cephalic version followed by vaginal delivery

h: Early ← Head compression. Variable ← Cord compression. Late ← Uteroplacental insufficiency.
q: During duty in the Labor and Delivery Room, the nurse called to evaluate the cardiotocography of PG 39 weeks in active labor. The nurse asked about the relationship between the cause and type of deceleration. Which of the following combinations is the most likely to occur?
o: Fetal head compression causes late deceleration
Fetal head compression causes variable deceleration

h: المفتاح ٨ ساعات. Latent phase طويل: أكثر من ٢٠ ساعة (nullipara) أو ١٤ (multipara) في المراجع.
q: A 28-year-old G4 P3 AO at 40 weeks of gestation presented with irregular contractions. She was admitted to the Labor and Delivery Ward. After how many hours will the latent phase be considered prolonged?

h: Hips flexed + knees extended = Frank breech. Complete breech ← hips + knees flexed.
q: A 35-year-old G3 P2002 woman presents to the clinic near term. Ultrasound demonstrates that the fetal head is in the fundus, the fetal spine is parallel to the mother's spine, with extended knees and flexed hips. Both arms are flexed at the elbows. Which of the following is the most appropriate description of fetal presentation?

h: Late decel ← Intrauterine resuscitation: hydrate + reposition + O2 وقف oxytocin، ثم أعيدي التقييم.
q: A 25-year-old woman was admitted at 36 weeks gestation in labor. Fetal monitoring trace shows late decelerations. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Hydrate, reposition, and review in 20 minutes

h: Fibroid بالحمل + ألم/حمى (red degeneration) ← Observation + analgesia. لا surgery.
q: A 37-year-old primigravida with uterine fibroid presented at 34 weeks of gestation with abdominal pain and fever. Examination revealed the cervix is closed, and no uterine contractions are felt. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Cyst أثناء cesarean ← Cystectomy (بدون aspiration/rupture).
q: A 21-year-old primigravida at 40 weeks of gestation with breech presentation is planned for a cesarean section. During surgery, a right ovarian cyst measuring 5 cm is observed. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Fistula + يمرر flatus/stool (بدون obstruction) ← NPO + secretion inhibitors (conservative).
q: A 35-year-old patient, 16 days post-cesarean section, presents with a fever that is not responding to antipyretics and antibiotics. She had four previous cesareans, and during surgery, extensive adhesions were found. She is passing urine, flatus, and stool. Examination reveals abdominal tenderness (see report). Contrast CT scan confirms the diagnosis of a small bowel fistula. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Restrict intake to a soft diet
NPO and start pancreatic and gastric secretion inhibitors

h: Active labor + contractions ضعيفة + CTG طبيعي ← Augmentation (oxytocin).
q: A 30-year-old G5P4 woman presents in labor at 39 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 7 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 120 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability and occasional variable decelerations. The uterine contractions are mild and irregular, occurring at a rate of 2 contractions in each 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Late decel + bradycardia + station عالي ← Emergency cesarean (لا instrumental).
q: A 30-year-old G5P4 woman presents in labor at 37 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 10 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 90 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability with recurrent late decelerations present. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Prolonged decel + fully dilated + station +3 ← Instrumental delivery (سريع).
q: A 28-year-old primigravida presents in labor at 37 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 10 cm dilated and the head is at +3 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 120 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability, and a prolonged deceleration was noted for the last 7 minutes. The uterine contractions are regular and strong. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Sinusoidal pattern = خطر شديد (fetal anemia/hypoxia) ← Cesarean.
q: A 20-year-old G2P1 presents in labor at 38 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 4 cm dilated. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 140 beats per minute with a sinusoidal pattern observed in the last 40 minutes. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Latent phase + contractions ضعيفة + CTG طبيعي ← Augmentation (المفتاح).
q: A 24-year-old primigravida at 39 weeks of gestation is in the latent phase of labor. Examination revealed the cervix is 2 cm dilated. Cardiotocography shows a baseline of 140 beats per minute, moderate variability, no decelerations, and no accelerations present. Uterine contractions are mild and irregular. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Poor variability + recurrent variable decel ← Emergency cesarean.
q: A 40-year-old G8P7 woman presents in active labor at 40 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix was found to be 7 cm dilated. Cardiotocography shows a baseline of 120 beats per minute, no decelerations, and poor variability with recurrent variable decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: الأخطر من النتائج ← Fetal tachycardia (استبعدي infection/hypoxia). Early decel طبيعي.
q: A 25-year-old G2P1 woman at 39 weeks of gestation presents in the active phase of labor. Cardiotocography shows fetal tachycardia with a baseline of 180 beats per minute, with accelerations, early deceleration, and good variability. Which of the following has the highest alarming sign?

h: CTG طبيعي + cervix غير متغير ← Reassurance (ليست labor).
q: A 30-year-old G3P2 woman presents with mild abdominal pain at 34 weeks of gestation. Cardiotocography shows a baseline of 140 beats per minute, good variability, accelerations were present with no decelerations. The examination is unremarkable, and the cervix was found to be 1 cm dilated and uneffaced. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: False labor ← Reassurance.
q: A 23-year-old primigravida presents with mild, infrequent abdominal pains at 36 weeks of gestation. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 140 beats per minute with good accelerations and variability and no decelerations. The uterine contractions are irregular and mild. The examination is unremarkable with no cervical dilation. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Absent variability + recurrent late decel ← Emergency cesarean.
q: A 28-year-old woman G3P2 at 38 weeks of gestation is in active labor. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 6 cm dilated.
