The cardiotocography is showing that the baseline is 120 beats per minute, absent accelerations and variability with recurrent late decelerations. Uterine contractions are strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 every minute. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Cord prolapse ← Variable decelerations + bradycardia.
q: A 23-year-old patient at 38 weeks of gestation is in active labor and diagnosed with cord prolapse. Which of the following is the most expected finding on CTG?

h: Labor بطيء + contractions خفيفة ← Augmentation (oxytocin).
q: A 33-year-old G3P2 woman presents with mild uterine contractions for 12 hours. Examination revealed fundal height corresponds to gestational age, cephalic presentation, and mild contractions. Pelvic assessment shows the cervix is 4 cm dilated, and the head is at -1 station. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: لو فيه stroke/acute chest/crises كثيرة ← Prophylactic transfusion. Hydroxyurea ممنوع بالحمل.
q: A 25-year-old woman is seen for a routine prenatal evaluation; she is 12 weeks pregnant. This is her second pregnancy; the first pregnancy was uncomplicated. Medical history is notable for sickle cell disease requiring 1 to 2 hospitalizations per year for painful events. She has no history of stroke or acute chest syndrome. Her only medication is a folic acid supplement. Cardiac examination reveals a grade 2/6 systolic flow murmur (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

h: DLCO واطي مع spirometry طبيعي ← PE أو ILD. FEV1 منخفض ← Obstructive.
q: A 35-year-old woman who had an uncomplicated vaginal delivery 2 weeks ago presented to the Emergency Room complaining of chest pain for 1 day, associated with exertional shortness of breath, no cough, no fever, no orthopnea, and no PND. Examination revealed an ill-looking woman (see reports). Pulmonary function test: FEV1 90% (80%-120%) FVC 95% (80%-120%) TLC 95% (80%-120%) DLCO 40% (60%-120%) Which of the following is the most likely cause of her shortness of breath?

h: Overt hypothyroidism ← ابدئي thyroxine فورًا. Subclinical + حمل ← Thyroxine أثناء الحمل.
q: A 32-year-old woman presents to the clinic with a 6-month history of mild fatigue. She does not have other symptoms. She is planning for pregnancy. Her physical examination is unremarkable. Her recent thyroid function is shown below. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Proceed with pregnancy without any interventions

h: Radioactive iodine ممنوع. Propylthiouracil بالثلث الأول، وmethimazole بعده.
q: A 30-year-old Primigravida is found to have hyperthyroidism during her pregnancy. Which of the following is the most contraindicated?

h: DVT بالحمل ← Compression ultrasonography أول. D-dimer ما ينفع بالحمل.
q: A 32-year-old PG at 25 weeks of gestation is complaining of severe left calf pain and swelling. The area of concern is slightly edematous, but no erythema is apparent. Examination demonstrates a positive Homan's sign. Which of the following is the most appropriate primary mode of diagnosis?

h: NYHA II: limitation بسيط. III: limitation واضح. IV: أعراض بالراحة.
q: A 23-year-old PG at 28 weeks of gestation known case of tricuspid regurgitation complaining of slight limitation of physical activity. What is her heart failure class based on the New York Heart Association classification?

h: Mitral stenosis أسوأ بالحمل (pulmonary edema). Regurgitant lesions تتحمل أحسن.
q: A 32-year-old woman, primigravida, presented with shortness of breath during an antenatal visit. She was diagnosed with cardiac valve disease. Which of the following is associated with the worst outcome?

h: Hypothyroidism بالحمل ← Thyroxine فورًا. Hyperthyroid ← Propylthiouracil.
q: A 24-year-old primigravida at her 11th week of pregnancy presents with a history of lethargy, constipation, and intolerance to cold temperature. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Intrahepatic cholestasis ← Bile acids + LFT.
q: A 25-year-old primigravida at 34 weeks' gestation presents with generalized pruritus and yellowish discoloration of the sclera and skin. Which of the following is the most important investigation?
o: Bile acids and liver function tests

h: Sickle cell disease ← Folic acid ٥ mg طوال الحمل. الاعتيادي ← ٤٠٠ mcg حتى ١٢ أسبوع.
q: A 20-year-old primigravida at 8 weeks' gestation is known to have sickle cell disease, while her husband has normal hemoglobin. She has not taken any vitamin supplements so far. Which of the following is the most appropriate folic acid supplement to be prescribed?

h: الحمل ← creatinine وBUN ينزلون (GFR يرتفع ٥٠٪).
q: A 24-year-old primigravida presents at 12 weeks gestation to an antenatal visit. Blood electrolytes and renal function tests were requested 3 days earlier. Which of the following is the most expected finding on her blood tests?
o: A fall in serum creatinine level
An increase of plasma sodium level
Increased plasma blood urea nitrogen level
Unaffected serum blood urea nitrogen level

h: Hydroxychloroquine آمن بالحمل ← كمّلي (يقلل flares).
q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy. She is 20 weeks pregnant and known to have SLE. She has been symptom-free for the past 2 years. She is taking Plaquenil daily. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Refer to Rheumatology to stop the medication

h: عند ١٢ أسبوع ← CVS. بعد ١٥ أسبوع ← Amniocentesis.
q: A 39-year-old G4 P3 at 12 weeks of gestation came for an ultrasound study. Ultrasound: Single viable fetus with cystic hygroma. Which of the following is the most appropriate step in management to be offered at this gestational age?

h: الحمل: Blood volume ↑ ٤٠–٥٠٪، وRBC mass ↑ ٢٠–٣٠٪ ← Hct ينزل (dilutional).
q: A 25-year-old primigravida presents at 15 weeks of gestation to the antenatal visit where blood and urine investigations were requested. Which of the following is the most expected finding?

h: قاعدة Naegele: LMP + ٧ أيام − ٣ شهور ≈ ١٤ فبراير. أقرب خيار بالأسئلة (Feb 10) هو المفتاح.
q: An 18-year-old G2 P1 presents for her first antenatal visit. The first day of her last menstrual period is May 7th. Her periods are regular, and she is sure about her periods. Which of the following is her estimated date of delivery?

h: Prolapse بالحمل بدون أعراض ← Conservative + reassurance. لا urgent delivery.
q: A 35-year-old pregnant patient at 29 weeks gestation notices a bulge protruding from the vagina. She denies any pain, discomfort, or urinary or gastrointestinal symptoms. Examination reveals grade 2 posterior vaginal prolapse. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Detailed anomaly scan ← ١٨–٢٢ أسبوع. Nuchal ← ١١–١٤.
q: A 25-year-old woman presents at 10 weeks of gestation for booking in the antenatal clinic. She gave a history of previous intrauterine death with multiple congenital anomalies. Which of the following is the most appropriate time for a detailed anomaly scan?

h: Androgenic progestin ← Masculinization of female genitalia.
q: A 33-year-old woman on oral contraceptive pills with strong androgenic progestin is seen in the clinic with a positive pregnancy test, where she is unaware of this pregnancy. Which of the following is the main teratogenic effect on the external genitalia of a female fetus?

h: CIN3/CIS مع رغبة بالحمل ← Conization. لو ما تبي حمل ← Hysterectomy.
q: A 32-year-old nulligravid healthy woman presents for a routine visit. Physical examination is entirely normal. She is a heavy cigarette smoker. She undergoes colposcopy and cervical biopsies (see reports). Pap smear: High grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL). Cervical biopsies: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ (CIS). After counseling about her condition, she wants to preserve her fertility if her status allows. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: المفتاح: hyperprolactinemia ← Bromocriptine (cabergoline). Clomid لو anovulation بدون prolactin.
q: A 30-year-old woman G0P0 presented with a history of infertility for 3 years (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: PPH: Call for help + cross-matched blood + ABC. لا تنقلين OR مباشرة قبل stabilize.
q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial step in managing this patient?
o: Start blood transfusion with O negative blood
Send blood tests and manage accordingly
Take her to the operating room for surgical management
Call for help and make sure there is cross-matched blood

h: Simple cyst بالحمل ← Observation (غالبًا corpus luteum). Torsion/rupture ← surgery.
q: A 23-year-old pregnant woman is seen at 9 weeks of gestation with moderate pelvic pain, which is dull in nature (see report). Ultrasound: Presence of an ovarian cyst of 4 cm in diameter. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: ARB/ACEi ممنوعة بالحمل ← Methyldopa أو labetalol أو nifedipine.
q: A 36-year-old woman who is hypertensive on hydrochlorothiazide and losartan presents to the clinic because of the absence of her menstrual cycle for 2 months. She is asymptomatic. Her physical examination is unremarkable. A pregnancy test was done and was positive (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment adjustment?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: hCG لازم ينزل ١٥٪ بين يوم ٤ و٧. لو ما نزل ← Second dose methotrexate. لو ruptured ← surgery.
q: A 35-year-old woman diagnosed with left tubal ectopic pregnancy was treated with methotrexate. She remained asymptomatic with a plateauing of Beta hCG on day 4 and day 7. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
o: Repeat Beta hCG in one week

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: Amenorrhea ← Pregnancy test أول.
q: A 30-year-old woman presented with a history of the absence of her period for the last 3 months. Which of the following is the most appropriate test?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: بعد IVF/ART ← Ectopic (أعلى خطر). لو pain + فحص hCG موجب ← فكري heterotopic.
q: A 35-year-old woman is complaining of severe abdominal pain. She is a known case of primary infertility and underwent embryo transfer 3 weeks ago (see lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: أي نزيف بعمر إنجابي ← Beta hCG أول (استبعدي الحمل).
q: A 30-year-old woman presented with intermenstrual vaginal bleeding for 5 days. Which of the following is the most appropriate investigation?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: LMP غير معروف ← Ultrasound الآن (CRL).
q: A 20-year-old woman came to the clinic for prenatal care. She missed her period for the last 6-8 weeks. Home pregnancy test was positive 2 weeks back and negative before that. Her periods were irregular and she is unsure of the last day of her menstrual period. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step for dating her pregnancy?
o: Wait 3-4 weeks then do an ultrasound
Counting from the positive urine pregnancy test

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: Ectopic stable ← Methotrexate. لو unstable/ruptured ← Surgery.
q: A 28-year-old woman presented with mild pelvic pain and spotting. She was diagnosed with an ectopic pregnancy and offered medical management. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication to treat this patient?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: AUB مع anemia/ضعف ← CBC + hCG أول (استبعدي حمل).
q: A 45-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room complaining that her period has not stopped for the past 15 days. Now she is feeling drowsy and easily fatigued and sometimes faints. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: أدق dating ← Crown-rump length (٧–١٣ أسبوع).
q: A 26-year-old woman in her first pregnancy came to the clinic. Her last menstrual period is unknown. Which of the following is the most reliable way of dating her pregnancy?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: بعد mole: hCG أسبوعيًا لين سلبي ثم شهريًا ٦ شهور. تجنبي الحمل خلال المتابعة.
q: A 35-year-old woman underwent an uneventful suction evacuation procedure for a suspected hydatidiform mole. The human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) level prior to the procedure was taken (see lab result and report). Histopathology: Confirmed the diagnosis of hydatidiform mole. Which of the following is the advised surveillance protocol by the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG)?
o: Weekly beta-hCG until 3 negative readings are obtained
Monthly beta-hCG until negative, then weekly for 6 months
Weekly beta-hCG until negative, then monthly for 6 months
Monthly beta-hCG until 3 negative readings are obtained

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: hCG لسه ما صار undetectable (١ ≠ ٠) ← Repeat weekly لين سلبي ثم monthly.
q: A 35-year-old woman underwent suction curettage for a molar pregnancy, and her betahCG level was 70,000 mIU/mL prior to the procedure. She was followed up with weekly betahCG levels for 5 weeks: 1st week post-evacuation: 576 mIU/mL 2nd week post-evacuation: 350 mIU/mL 3rd week post-evacuation: 180 mIU/mL 4th week post-evacuation: 70 mIU/mL 5th week post-evacuation: 1 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: hCG ينزل ثم يرتفع (٧٠ ← ٣٠٠) + mass ← GTN ← Metastatic workup بدون biopsy (خطر نزيف).
q: A 35-year-old woman presents with unusual vaginal bleeding and a fleshy vaginal mass. She underwent a suction evacuation for hydatidiform mole. Her beta-hCG level was 870,000 mIU/mL prior to the procedure. She was followed with weekly beta-hCG levels for 5 weeks, with the following results: 1st week: 576 mIU/mL 2nd week: 350 mIU/mL 3rd week: 180 mIU/mL 4th week: 70 mIU/mL 5th week: 300 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Perform a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis
Perform a metastatic workup without biopsy

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: امرأة بعمر إنجابي بألم حاد + amenorrhea ← Pregnancy test أول (تؤكد/تستبعد ectopic).
q: A 35-year-old woman presents to the Emergency Room with sudden severe abdominal pain for the last three hours, sharp in nature and radiating to the right shoulder. She has an irregular menstrual cycle, and the last episode was six weeks ago. Examination reveals guarding and rigidity of the abdomen. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: Ruptured ectopic مع unstable ← Laparotomy فورًا.
q: A 30-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with sudden severe and sharp abdominal pain for the last three hours, radiating to the right shoulder. She has an irregular menstrual cycle, and the last episode was six weeks ago. Examination revealed a rigid abdomen with guarding of note (see report). Pelvic Ultrasound: Abundant fluid in the pouch of Douglas. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: أدق dating ← Crown-rump length (٧–١٣ أسبوع).
q: A 22-year-old woman presents to the booking clinic after performing a home pregnancy test, which was positive. She is not sure of her dates, as she has irregular menses. Which of the following is the most appropriate test for dating her pregnancy?

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: hCG ما نزل ١٥٪ يوم ٤–٧ ← Second dose (إن stable). ينزل ≥ ١٥٪ ← متابعة.
q: A 26-year-old woman was treated with methotrexate for an ectopic pregnancy. Her BhCG results are as follows: - Baseline test was 3000 miu/ml on the day of the injection - Day 4: BhCG was 3100 miu/ml - Day 7: BhCG was 2900 miu/ml Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Administer a multiple dose regimen of methotrexate
Counsel for the possibility of administering a second methotrexate dose

t: Early pregnancy: ectopic, molar, miscarriage & dating
h: hCG نزل ≥ ١٥٪ + stable ← Reassure ومتابعة (ألم خفيف شائع).
q: A 26-year-old woman was treated with methotrexate 8 days ago for ectopic pregnancy and presents to the Emergency Room with mild abdominal pain and vaginal spotting. Examination revealed a soft and non-tender abdomen. Her BhCG results show a drop from 1200 miu/ml on Day 4 to 500 miu/ml on Day 7. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Infertility ← Semen analysis أول (أسهل وأرخص) قبل فحوص الزوجة.
q: A 35-year-old smoker man and a 26-year-old woman presented with primary infertility for 3 years. The wife had 3 cycles of Clomid as a case of polycystic ovaries. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Hormonal profile day 2 of the cycle

h: Primary oligomenorrhea صغيرة ← Chromosomal analysis (Turner mosaic). Prolactin/TSH روتينية.
q: A 20-year-old woman presented with a history of primary infertility for 1 year. She had a history of scanty irregular cycles with prolonged intervals (see lab results). Which of the following is the important workup?

h: Secondary amenorrhea + FSH عالي قبل ٤٠ ← Premature ovarian insufficiency. PCOS ← LH/FSH + hirsutism.
q: A 26-year-old woman, her menarche was at the age of 15 years. Her last cycle was 9 months ago (see lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Ovulation ← Progesterone day 21 (mid-luteal).
q: A 26-year-old woman with primary infertility is seen in the gynecology clinic for investigations. Her FSH, LH, and serum prolactin are normal. Pelvic Ultrasound is also reported as normal. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value for ovulation?

h: Molar pregnancy ← Suction evacuation (مو medical).
q: A 26-year-old woman presents with amenorrhea for the last 14 weeks. She started to have mild vaginal bleeding for the last 3 days. Examination revealed the uterine size is 18 weeks and is doughy on palpation. Ultrasound: An enlarged uterus with a snowstorm appearance. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Premature ovarian insufficiency (FSH عالي) ← HRT. حمل يحتاج donor eggs.
q: A 25-year-old woman is seen in the infertility clinic as a case of primary infertility for 2 years. Her history revealed that she has had amenorrhea for the last 6 months and only gets menstruation through using withdrawal bleeding pills. She had investigations repeated twice, performed 3 months apart, and they were all showing the same results. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: PCOS + infertility ← Clomiphene (أول). Metformin/letrozole بدائل.
q: A 24-year-old woman has been trying to get pregnant for the last 18 months. She was recently diagnosed with polycystic ovarian syndrome and has irregular menstrual cycles. Her husband's semen analysis was normal, and she has not received any medication. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Oral contraceptives to regulate the menstrual cycle

h: Snowstorm ← Molar pregnancy ← hCG (عالي جدًا).
q: A 45-year-old otherwise healthy woman presents to the clinic complaining of amenorrhea for the last 18 weeks. Her periods prior to this were all regular. Ultrasound: Presence of a snowstorm pattern within the uterine cavity. Which of the following is the most appropriate test to reach the diagnosis?

h: Amenorrhea + tissue ← Pelvic examination + Ultrasound (يحدد نوع abortion).
q: A 22-year-old, otherwise healthy woman, presents to the Emergency Room complaining of amenorrhea for the last 8 weeks and expelling blood and tissue through the vagina. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
o: Pelvic examination and CT scan of the pelvis

h: COC يخفف menorrhagia وdysmenorrhea. لو smoker فوق ٣٥ أو migraine with aura ← Progestin-only.
q: A 20-year-old nulliparous healthy married woman presents to the clinic requesting contraception. She has a history of menorrhagia and occasional dysmenorrhea. No family history of note. Which of the following is the most appropriate contraception method?

h: Intracavitary lesion صغيرة ← Endometrial polyp. Fibroid ← uterus كبير. Adenomyosis ← uterus globular.
q: A 42-year-old P3003 healthy woman presents with a history of heavy and prolonged vaginal bleeding over the past 7 months. Her periods have become longer and progressively heavier. Her LMP was 15 days ago. Pelvic examination reveals a small amount of blood in the vaginal vault, a normal-sized uterus, and mobile ovaries. Pelvic ultrasound: 2.5 cm x 1.5 cm lesion in the uterine cavity. Which of the following is the most likely cause of bleeding?

h: Asymptomatic fibroid ← Conservative. Surgery بس لو أعراض.
q: A 33-year-old single woman was found to have a uterine fibroid incidentally on pelvic ultrasound. Ultrasound: Subserosal uterine fibroid measuring 5x5 cm. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Menorrhagia + mass ← Pelvic ultrasound أول (MRI بعد لو قرار surgery).
q: A 33-year-old woman presents with a complaint of a heavy menstrual cycle. During examination, a firm fundal mass was felt. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Postmenopausal bleeding أشيع سبب ← Atrophy. لكن لازم تستبعدين cancer (endometrial thickness).
q: A 60-year-old menopausal woman presents with recent on-and-off vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most common cause of her complaint?

h: Endometrial polyp ← Hysteroscopy + removal (تشخيص + علاج).
q: A 43-year-old woman presented with intermenstrual bleeding in the last 3 months (see report). Ultrasound: A 13 mm long echogenic structure in the endometrium. Which of the following is the most appropriate management option?
o: Hysteroscopy and removal of the structure

h: UTI بعد الجماع ← Postcoital single-dose antibiotic. Frequent ← prophylaxis daily.
q: A 30-year-old woman presented with a history of recurrent urinary tract infections. She notices it happening after sexual intercourse. Which of the following is the most appropriate recommendation?

h: Menorrhagia + uterus كبير ← Fibroids (leiomyomas). Polyp ← intermenstrual.
q: A 23-year-old single woman presented with heavy menstruation during the first 4 days of her period for the last 2 years (see image and lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Asymptomatic fibroid ← Conservative. Surgery لو أعراض أو حمل مخطط.
q: A 23-year-old single girl diagnosed with a 5*5 cm uterine leiomyoma incidentally during a kidney ultrasound. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: Fibroid + heavy bleeding + anemia ← صححي الـanemia أول (iron) قبل الجراحة.
q: A 35-year-old woman with a leiomyoma associated with heavy menstruation (see image and lab result). Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: Cyclic pain + dyschezia + laparoscopy ← Endometriosis.
q: A 33-year-old woman, nulliparous, complaining of cyclic pelvic pain and dyschezia underwent diagnostic laparoscopy (see image). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Cervical mass ← Punch biopsy (مو Pap). Pap للـscreening.
q: A 45-year-old woman presented to the clinic complaining of postcoital bleeding. Pelvic examination revealed a 2*1 cm cervical mass. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: AUB + symptomatic anemia شديد (Hb منخفض جدًا) ← Blood transfusion.
q: A 45-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room complaining that her period has not stopped for the past 15 days and now she is feeling drowsy and easily fatigued (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Manage the bleeding and send her home

h: عمر ٢٥ + atypical hyperplasia ← High-dose progesterone (تحافظ على fertility). بعد ٤٥ أو انتهاء الإنجاب ← Hysterectomy.
q: A 25-year-old woman presented with abnormal uterine bleeding, underwent an endometrial biopsy (see report). Endometrial biopsy: Atypical complex hyperplasia. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Large fibroid + عمر ٥١ وانتهى الإنجاب ← Hysterectomy. لو تبي fertility ← Myomectomy.
q: A 51-year-old woman P6+2 presents with pelvic pressure, heaviness in the lower abdomen, and heavy menstrual bleeding. Bimanual pelvic examination revealed a firm, irregular, enlarged uterus is felt (see report). Pelvic Ultrasound: A large submucous fibroid 7x8 cm in size. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Heavy bleeding + fibroid ← Submucosal (يسبب menorrhagia). Subserosal ← pressure.
q: A 42-year-old woman presented with pelvic pressure, bloating, and heaviness in the lower abdomen. Her cycle is prolonged with heavy menstrual bleeding (see report). Ultrasound: Presence of uterine fibroid. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Parous + diffusely tender enlarged uterus ← Adenomyosis. Endometriosis ← nulliparous، uterus طبيعي.
q: A 42-year-old P4+2 presented with severe, progressive secondary dysmenorrhea and menorrhagia. Pelvic examination demonstrated a tender, diffusely enlarged uterus (see report). Endometrial biopsy: Normal endometrium. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: قبل myomectomy ← GnRH agonist (يصغر fibroid ويقلل blood loss).
q: A 38-year-old woman is scheduled to undergo a myomectomy due to the presence of a large uterine fibroid. The surgeon is planning to administer medication that will help reduce the size of the uterine fibroid prior to performing the procedure. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication to use for this purpose?

h: بديل للـhysterectomy مع fibroid كبير + رغبة بالحفاظ ← Uterine artery embolization.
q: A 38-year-old woman presents with pelvic pressure and menorrhagia. She was diagnosed to have a large uterine anterior wall fibroid of 10 cm in size. Ultrasound shows a distorted endometrial lining secondary to the fibroid. The patient was offered hysterectomy but she declined. Which of the following is the most appropriate alternative management?

h: Asymptomatic small fibroid ← Reassure ومتابعة.
q: A 24-year-old woman presents to the clinic with an incidental finding of a uterine fibroid. Her menstrual cycle is regular, and her examination is unremarkable. Ultrasound: An anterior subserosal fibroid of 3 x 2 cm, otherwise the other areas of the uterus, ovaries, and adnexa are unremarkable. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Serosal fibroid ما يسبب menorrhagia عادة ← NSAIDs (أو ابحثي عن سبب ثاني). Surgery لا.
q: A 32-year-old single woman is attending the clinic complaining of menorrhagia for the last few months. The physical examination is unremarkable. Pelvic Ultrasound: Presence of a serosal fibroid, 4 x 4 cm in size. Otherwise, the other parameters of the ultrasound were normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: فشل medical + fibroid كبير + عمر ٥٠ ← Hysterectomy.
q: A 50-year-old woman presents with menorrhagia for the last year. The physical examination is unremarkable. A trial of medical treatment failed to control the bleeding for the last few months. Ultrasound: Presence of a fibroid, 7 x 7 cm in size, which is distorting the endometrial lining. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Fibroids + infertility + فشل IVF ← Myomectomy.
q: A 25-year-old woman has been seeking fertility for the last 3 years. She had 2 unsuccessful in vitro fertilization trials. Pelvic Ultrasound: Multiple uterine fibroids of variable sizes. Which of the following will most likely increase her chance of reaching a successful pregnancy?
o: GnRH injection to reduce the size of the fibroids

h: Postmenopausal bleeding حتى مع fibroid قديم ← Endometrial sample أول.
q: A 60-year-old woman is attending the clinic complaining of post-menopausal bleeding for the last 3 months. She was found to have a uterine fibroid of 5 cm in size, noted in a recent ultrasound. Upon review of the previous medical records, the ultrasound performed 5 years ago showed the same size and location of the fibroid. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Hyperplasia بدون atypia ← Progesterone (IUD هرموني أو oral).
q: A 40-year-old woman presents with menorrhagia for the last 6 months. She underwent an endometrial biopsy. Endometrial biopsy: Presence of simple endometrial hyperplasia without atypia. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Endometrium سميك + AUB + DM/HTN ← Endometrial biopsy (استبعدي hyperplasia/cancer).
q: A 45-year-old woman presents with menorrhagia for the last 8 months. She is known to be diabetic and hypertensive. Ultrasound: Thickened endometrial lining of approximately 23 mm. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
o: CT of the abdomen and pelvis

h: PMS: قبل الدورة وتتحسن بعدها. لو الألم يستمر بعد الدورة ← Endometriosis.
q: A 34-year-old healthy woman presents with recurrent symptoms, including headache, anxiety, and mastalgia, that start 8-10 days before menstruation and improve afterward. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Vaginal atrophy فقط ← Local estrogen cream. Systemic hot flashes ← Systemic estrogen.
q: A 53-year-old woman, whose last menstrual period was 18 months ago, is complaining of dyspareunia for the past few months. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: صورة laparoscopy: endometriotic implants (chocolate/ powder-burn) ← Endometriosis.
q: A 28-year-old woman presented with a history of secondary infertility for 4 years (see image). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Irregular cycle + semen طبيعي ← Ovulatory dysfunction (PCOS).
q: A 30-year-old woman married for 3 years with a history of an irregular cycle. Her husband's seminal analysis was normal. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

h: فشل NSAIDs ← هرمونات: COC أو progestin. المفتاح هنا Oral progesterone.
q: A 30-year-old woman diagnosed with endometriosis tried non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agents but is still symptomatic. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management?

h: Adenomyosis (parous + MRI thick myometrium) ← Hysterectomy (definitive).
q: A 45-year-old woman P6 is complaining of chronic pelvic pain and heavy menstruation (see report). Pelvic MRI: Diffuse thickened myometrium. Which of the following is the most definitive treatment for her condition?

h: Dysmenorrhea ← Menstrual history أهم (primary vs secondary).
q: A 32-year-old woman presented to the Gynecology Clinic with dysmenorrhea. Which of the following is the most important history for evaluation?

h: شك endometriosis + فحص tubal patency ← Laparoscopy + dye (يشخص ويعالج). HSG لو بدون شك pelvic disease.
q: A 32-year-old woman presents to the Infertility Clinic for investigations. She has been married for the last 3 years and is complaining of dysmenorrhea and deep dyspareunia. Abdominal and pelvic examination revealed no pathology. Which of the following is the most appropriate investigation for tubal patency?

h: Urge incontinence (OAB) ← Anticholinergics. Stress ← Kegel/sling.
q: A 54-year-old menopausal woman presents with a history of involuntary urine leaks with urgency. The complaint occurs at any time during the day or night, without warning. There is no clear association between leaks and any specific activity, with occasional association with coughing and laughing. Physical examination is unremarkable. Urinalysis and culture are negative. Urodynamic study shows spontaneous bladder contractions even with small bladder filling. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

h: High surgical risk (DM + HF) ← Vaginal pessary.
q: A 62-year-old postmenopausal woman (P4014), known diabetic and with congestive heart failure, is referred by a Cardiology Clinic. She has occasional incontinence with coughing and sneezing. During the interview, she also complains of lower abdominal heaviness and vaginal bulging. Pelvic examination reveals second-degree pelvic prolapse. Which of the following is the recommended treatment for this woman?

h: Estrogen بدون progesterone ← hyperplasia/cancer ← أضيفي Progesterone (uterus موجود).
q: A 55-year-old woman presents with on-and-off vaginal bleeding. She is menopausal for 3 years and has been taking conjugated estrogen pills. There is no previous surgical history. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
o: Shift her to oral contraceptive pills

h: أول خطوة ← Lifestyle modification. HRT لو شديد وبدون contraindication.
q: A 50-year-old woman is complaining of hot flashes and insomnia. Which of the following is the most appropriate first-line management?

h: Atypical hyperplasia + غير صالحة للعمل ← Continuous progesterone (بديل).
q: A 70-year-old woman presented with post-menopausal bleeding for the last 7 months. Endometrial biopsy: Endometrial hyperplasia with atypia. She is unfit for surgery and anesthesia. Which of the following is the most appropriate alternative management?

h: Endometrial lesion + biopsy طبيعي ← Sonohysterogram/ hysteroscopy يميز polyp عن fibroid.
q: A 42-year-old P3003 healthy woman presents with heavy prolonged vaginal bleeding over the past 7 months. Her periods have become longer and progressively heavier, with the last one occurring 15 days ago. Pelvic examination reveals a small amount of blood in the vaginal vault, normal-sized uterus, and mobile ovaries. (See reports.) Pelvic ultrasound: Endometrium 13 mm and a 2.2 cm x 1 cm lesion in the uterine cavity. Endometrial biopsy: Normal histology. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Magnetic resonance imaging of the uterus
Evaluate hemoglobin level and coagulopathy screening

h: Postmenopausal bleeding أشيع سبب ← Endometrial atrophy. cancer الأخطر.
q: A 60-year-old woman presented with a history of intermittent vaginal bleeding over the last 2 months. There is no history of weight loss. No past surgical or medical history, and she is not on any medication. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

h: PMB + endometrium > 4 mm ← Endometrial biopsy. أقل ← يطمن.
q: A 60-year-old woman with a history of intermittent vaginal bleeding (see report). Ultrasound: Endometrial thickness of 8 mm and ovaries detected. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: AUB + obesity + DM + سماكة كبيرة ← Endometrial sample (استبعدي hyperplasia/cancer).
q: A 46-year-old woman is complaining of heavy menstruation lasting for 14 days every period. She is morbidly obese and has type 2 diabetes mellitus (see lab results and report). Ultrasound: Endometrial thickness of 18 mm. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: Post-coital bleeding ← Pap smear + cervical exam (استبعدي cervical cancer) أول.
q: A 41-year-old woman Para 4 presented to the Gynecology Clinic with post-coital bleeding for the past three months. Her cycle is irregular, and she is not taking any contraception. Examination revealed a soft abdomen with no palpable masses. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Atypical hyperplasia + عمر ٥٠ ← Hysterectomy.
q: A 50-year-old woman presented to the clinic with prolonged and heavy menstruation for the last 8 months. She underwent an endometrial biopsy. Endometrial biopsy: Presence of endometrial hyperplasia with atypia. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Breast bud = Tanner II. III ← breast أكبر بدون separation. IV ← double contour.
q: A 13-year-old healthy girl is brought by her mother with concerns about not yet starting menstruation. Examination reveals sparse hair covering the labia majora, not extending onto the mons pubis. She has developed breast buds and papilla and areolar enlargement, with no separation in contour between the breast and areola. Which Tanner stage would this girl be assigned to?

h: Abnormal Pap ← Colposcopy (+ biopsy). لا إعادة بعد ٣ شهور في HSIL.
q: A 24-year-old sexually active woman presented to the Gynecology Clinic with vaginal discharge. A Pap smear showed abnormal results. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Ovarian cancer ← Surgery + Chemotherapy. Early stage I ← surgery فقط.
q: A 58-year-old woman P2002 presents with a history of heaviness in the pelvis, discomfort, and abdominal distension over the last 6 months. Examination reveals a distended abdomen with significant discomfort on palpation and a large abdominopelvic mass. (See report.) Ultrasound and CT: A 12 cm left ovarian mass, ascites, and thickening of the peritoneum. Which of the following is the mainstay of treatment for the suspected diagnosis?

h: Ovarian torsion ← Laparoscopy (detorsion/cystectomy) فورًا. Doppler الطبيعي ما ينفي.
q: A 25-year-old woman, known to have a left ovarian cyst, presented to the Emergency Room with 3 hours of severe left lower quadrant pain associated with nausea. Ultrasound Doppler: Diminished blood flow toward the left ovary. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?

h: Ovarian cancer staging ← Surgical staging (laparotomy).
q: A 50-year-old woman presented with a right ovarian mass. Examination revealed abdominal ascites. Her epithelial tumor marker is high. Which of the following is the most appropriate way to stage her tumor?
o: CT for chest, abdomen, and pelvis

h: Fatty material + hair/teeth ← Dermoid (Cystic teratoma).
q: A 30-year-old woman underwent ovarian cystectomy. While the nurse was preparing the specimen to be sent to histopathology, there was a leak of thick fatty material from the cyst. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: Postmenopausal complex adnexal mass ← Pelvic MRI للتصنيف (أو gyne-oncology) قبل أي surgery.
q: A 65-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with a history of acute abdominal pain that increased markedly in the last few hours (see report). A solitary, cystic, right complex adnexal mass was observed. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: شابة + complex mass ← Cystectomy (حافظي على الـovary).
q: A 20-year-old asymptomatic woman presented to the clinic with lower abdominal pain for 3 months (see lab result and report). Ultrasound: A multiloculated, solid, right adnexal complex mass of 6 cm. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: نفس الـmass عند ٧٦ ← Consult gynecologic oncology (خطر malignancy عالي).
q: A 76-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with a 1-week history of abdominal pain (see lab result and report). Ultrasound: A multiloculated, solid, right adnexal complex mass of 6 cm. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy

h: Simple cyst عند شابة ← Reassess بعد ٦–٨ أسابيع (functional cyst).
q: A 20-year-old asymptomatic woman presented to the clinic with an incidental ultrasound finding that showed a simple right adnexal mass of 5 cm in size. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Epithelial ovarian cancer ← CA-125. Germ cell ← hCG وAFP. Granulosa ← inhibin.
q: A 60-year-old woman presented with weight loss and loss of appetite (see report). Ultrasound: Multiloculated, solid, right adnexal mass. Which of the following is the most essential tumor marker during the work-up?

h: المفتاح: Enterocele. Cystocele ← أمامي. Rectocele ← خلفي.
q: A 58-year-old woman (P6006) presents with a 2-month history of pelvic heaviness and a sensation of lower pelvic pressure. Examination reveals vulvar atrophy, mucosal bulging through the introitus, and the rest of the pelvic examination is within normal limits. Which of the following is the most likely underlying etiology of this woman's complaint?

h: Gonorrhea ← Endocervical swab (NAAT/culture). Urine NAAT برضو ممكن.
q: A 35-year-old woman is complaining of vaginal discharge and burning with urination. Her husband was recently diagnosed with gonorrhea. Which of the following tests has the highest diagnostic value?

h: Fishy odor ← Bacterial vaginosis (clue cells). Frothy أخضر ← Trichomonas. Cottage cheese ← Candida.
q: A 30-year-old woman is complaining of yellowish, fishy-smelling vaginal discharge and itching. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: White + itching ← Candidiasis (cottage cheese). Fishy ← BV.
q: A 25-year-old woman is complaining of whitish vaginal discharge and itching for 3 days. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

h: PE ← CT pulmonary angiography. لو حامل أو renal failure ← V/Q.
q: A 35-year-old woman presents to the Emergency Room with sudden onset of shortness of breath associated with pleuritic chest pain. Her past medical history is unremarkable. She is using oral contraceptives regularly. Physical examination is unremarkable. Imaging and laboratory tests are requested. Which of the following is the most appropriate investigation to establish the diagnosis?

h: Primary dysmenorrhea ← NSAIDs أول.
q: An 18-year-old girl complains of severe lower abdominal pain and back pain on the first 2 days of her cycle every period. She has a regular cycle and is medically free. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: فشل NSAIDs ← Oral contraceptive pills. لو ما تحسن ← laparoscopy (endometriosis).
q: An 18-year-old girl complains of severe lower abdominal pain and back pain on the first 2 days of her cycle every period. She has a regular cycle and is medically free. Tried NSAID but no improvement was noticed. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: PE سابق ← ممنوع estrogen (COC/patch). IUD أو progestin-only آمن.
q: A 43-year-old woman with a history of pulmonary embolism 3 years ago is seeking an effective family planning method. Which of the following is the most appropriate method?

h: AUB حاد شديد غير مستقر ← D&C (تشخيص وعلاج). المستقر ← medical (tranexamic/ hormonal).
q: A 44-year-old woman presented with heavy vaginal bleeding (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Primary dysmenorrhea شديد ← Combined hormonal contraceptive pills (تكبح ovulation).
q: A 23-year-old woman came to the clinic complaining of severe pain the day prior to menses, continuing for 2 days. The pain is so severe that she misses work. Which of the following is the most appropriate to control her pain so that she can go to work?

h: Infertility ≥ 12 شهر ← Investigate الاثنين (ما تنتظرين).
q: A 30-year-old woman married for 3 years has been off contraceptive pills for the last 18 months and has not gotten pregnant. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Infertility investigation for her and her husband

h: المفتاح: Hormonal vaginal ring. أفعل reversible: IUD/implant. Condoms أقل.
q: A 34-year-old is inquiring about an effective reversible method of contraception. Which of the following is the most effective method of contraception?

h: Cardiac + anticoagulant ← Progestin-only (estrogen ممنوع). IUD ممكن لكن نزيف.
q: A 29-year-old known cardiac patient receiving anticoagulants is seen in the clinic for contraceptive advice. Which of the following is the most appropriate contraceptive method?

h: Unexplained + فشل clomiphene ← Diagnostic laparoscopy أول (استبعدي endometriosis/tubal).
q: A 30-year-old woman with primary infertility for the last 3 years is seen for follow-up in the clinic. Her investigations included a hormonal profile, and an ultrasound is normal. Her husband's semen analysis is also normal. She had a 3-month trial of induction of ovulation with clomiphene. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: HSG proximal block (ممكن spasm) ← Laparoscopy + dye للتأكد قبل IVF.
q: A 21-year-old woman with primary infertility for the last 4 years is seen in the clinic for follow-up. Investigation showed that her hormonal profile is normal and her husband's semen analysis is also normal. The hysterosalpingogram showed proximal blocked tubes bilaterally. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Bilateral tubal block مؤكد ← IVF.
q: A 26-year-old woman with primary infertility for the last 4 years presents for follow-up in the clinic. The investigations showed a normal hormonal profile, and her husband's semen analysis was also normal. She underwent hysterosalpingography and diagnostic laparoscopy and dye test, which confirmed the presence of bilateral tubal blockage. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Tube واحد مفتوح + ovulation طبيعي ← Ovulation induction (Clomiphene) أول.
q: A 26-year-old woman has primary infertility for the last 4 years. Her investigations revealed a normal hormonal profile and her husband's semen analysis is also normal. She underwent hysterosalpingography and diagnostic laparoscopy and dye test that confirmed the presence of a right fallopian tube blockage but the left tube was found to be patent. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: Ovulation + semen طبيعي ← فحص Fallopian tubal patency (HSG).
q: A 25-year-old woman is seeking fertility assistance and had undergone investigations that revealed that ovulation is regular and her husband's semen analysis is adequate. Which of the following is required to complete the assessment?

h: لو الأعراض في الدماغ (seizure/psychosis) ← MRI brain. ولو areflexia ← فكري GBS.
q: A 28-year-old woman with systemic lupus erythematosus for 2 years on hydroxychloroquine 200 mg/day, prednisone 5 mg/day, and azathioprine 100 mg/day presented to the Emergency Room with sudden onset of lower limb weakness and urinary incontinence. Examination revealed she has paraplegia and hyperreflexia (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate test to be done immediately?
o: Lumbar puncture, MRI, MRA, and MRV of the brain

h: لو ما تبي surgery ← Pessary. Frail + بدون نشاط جنسي ← Colpocleisis.
q: A 70-year-old married woman presents with a large prolapse. She has no other significant history except an abdominal hysterectomy at the age of 48 for heavy periods. Examination shows vaginal vault prolapse extending beyond the introitus and a very deficient perineum with a large vaginal opening. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Cystocele ← Anterior colporrhaphy. لو uterine prolapse أشد ← Vaginal hysterectomy.
q: A 44-year-old P6006 woman had second-degree uterine descent and moderate cystorectocele. Which of the following is the most appropriate choice of management?

h: المفتاح: Rectocele. (السمنة ترفع الضغط داخل البطن).
q: A 49-year-old morbidly obese woman presents with a history of pelvic organ prolapse. Her BMI is 48 kg/m². Which of the following is the most expected type of prolapse in her case?

h: Stress incontinence ← Hypermobile urethra. Urgency incontinence ← detrusor overactivity.
q: A 50-year-old woman (P5005) presents to the clinic complaining of urine leakage while coughing and sneezing. She denies any frequency, dysuria, or urgency. Which of the following is the most likely finding on physical examination?

h: Splinting ← Rectocele ← Posterior colporrhaphy.
q: A 64-year-old otherwise healthy woman presents with a history of constipation and difficulty with defecation. She reports using her fingers to push her vagina backward to pass bowel motions. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

h: Symptomatic cystocele كبير ← Anterior colporrhaphy. خفيف أو ما تبي surgery ← Pessary.
q: A 44-year-old woman (P5005) presents to the clinic with an uncomfortable sensation in the vagina for the last year. She reports pelvic pressure associated with urinary frequency but no urinary leaks or irregular menstruation. Obstetric history includes 5 term spontaneous vaginal deliveries. She works in loading and unloading heavy boxes. Examination reveals a large bulging of the anterior vaginal wall. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: Stress incontinence ← Kegel exercises أول (conservative).
q: A 45-year-old healthy woman (P4004) presents with a complaint of urine leaks when she laughs, coughs, or sneezes. She denies any history of frequency, dysuria, nocturia, or hematuria. She does not report urge voiding when hearing running water. Her symptoms are embarrassing and inconvenient. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial therapy?

h: Stress incontinence ← Cough stress test (leak مع cough بمثانة ممتلئة).
q: A 50-year-old woman with a history of involuntary urine leak, especially when she runs. Which of the following is the most appropriate next clinical evaluation?

h: Prolapse + incomplete emptying + recurrent UTI ← Post-void residual volume.
q: A 60-year-old woman presented with urinary tract infection for the second time in the last 6 months. She is feeling vaginal bulging and has difficulty emptying her bladder completely. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: قبل تشخيص OAB ← Urine culture (استبعدي infection).
q: A 40-year-old woman complaining of frequency and urgency for 1 month. A suspicion is raised of overactive bladder syndrome. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: High surgical risk ← Pessary. Colpocleisis لو ما تستخدم pessary وبدون intercourse.
q: An 80-year-old woman known case of prosthetic heart valve on warfarin and bedridden. Diagnosed as stage 3 pelvic organ prolapse. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: أكثر علاج فعال لـSUI ← Midurethral sling. Conservative: Kegel/pessary.
q: A 40-year-old woman diagnosed with stress urinary incontinence. During counseling, she wants the most effective treatment for her condition. Which of the following is the most appropriate recommendation?

h: Asymptomatic prolapse ← Conservative وreassurance. Surgery بس لو symptoms.
q: A 60-year-old woman presents for a routine gynecology checkup. She is asymptomatic, but an incidental finding of grade 3 posterior vaginal wall prolapse was detected. She denies any symptoms related to urine or stool incontinence. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?

h: High surgical risk + مو منزعجة ← Vaginal pessary.
q: A 90-year-old woman, diabetic and hypertensive, is admitted with heart failure, controlled on medications. An incidental finding of uterine procidentia was detected. The patient states that she has had this condition for over 10 years but it has never bothered her. She pushes the uterus back into place to help with urination and defecation. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial treatment?

h: Mild/early ← Pelvic floor exercise + reassurance. Surgery لو تضرر الحياة.
q: A 50-year-old woman para 5 attends the clinic complaining of mild pelvic pressure symptoms. She denies any urinary, fecal, or gas incontinence. Examination reveals grade 2 posterior vaginal wall prolapse. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Pelvic floor exercise, reassurance, and follow-up

h: فشل conservative ٦ شهور + grade 3 ← Counsel for surgical management.
q: A 50-year-old woman was managed conservatively for the last 6 months for grade 3 posterior vaginal prolapse, experiencing mild to moderate pelvic discomfort. Examination today shows similar findings with no progression or improvement. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in her management?

h: أعراض UTI + prolapse ← Urine analysis أول قبل أي surgery.
q: An 80-year-old woman presents with urgency, frequency, and burning micturition for the past week. Examination reveals grade 2 anterior and vaginal prolapse. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: Recent onset (أسبوع) + عروس ← Urine analysis/culture (UTI) أول.
q: A 20-year-old healthy woman, recently married, presents with a 1-week history of urgency and occasional urinary incontinence. Pelvic examination is unremarkable. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

h: Mild SUI ← Pelvic floor exercise أول. بعدها pessary/surgery لو فشل.
q: A 38-year-old woman P4+0 presented to the clinic with mild stress urinary incontinence, which was proven by the cough stress test. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

h: شك Sheehan: اطلبي TSH/Free T4 قبل أي علاج. ولا تعطين levothyroxine قبل cortisol.
q: A 38-year-old woman, mother of three, presents with fatigue and weight loss for the last few months. She was unable to breastfeed her last child and her menses did not return after giving birth. She has cold intolerance and loss of appetite. Examination reveals a croaky voice with delayed relaxation phase of her ankle jerks (see lab results). What is the next step in management?
